iast: saba sukha lahai tumhārī saranā । / tuma racchaka kāhū ko ḍara nā
sayIt: sub SOOKH la-HAI tum-HAA-ree sa-ra-NAA / tum RUCH-chuk KAA-hoo ko DA-ra naa
translation: In your refuge one finds every happiness; with you as protector, there is no fear of anyone.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 22, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: What fear would loosen its grip today if you truly believed you were not facing it alone?

translations.hi: तुम्हारी शरण में सब सुख मिलते हैं; तुम रक्षक हो, तो किसी का कोई डर नहीं।

devanagari: आपन तेज संहारो आपै । / तीनों लोक हाँक तें काँपै
iast: āpana teja saṃhāro āpai । / tīnoṃ loka hām̐ka teṃ kām̐pai
sayIt: AA-pun tayj sun-HAA-ro AA-pai / TEE-no lok HAANK tayn KAAM-pai
translation: You alone can contain your own splendour; all three worlds tremble at your roar.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 23, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: Where today could you hold your strength in check instead of proving it?

translations.hi: अपना तेज तुम स्वयं ही सँभाल सकते हो; तुम्हारी हुंकार से तीनों लोक काँप उठते हैं।

devanagari: भूत पिसाच निकट नहिं आवै । / महाबीर जब नाम सुनावै
iast: bhūta pisāca nikaṭa nahiṃ āvai । / mahābīra jaba nāma sunāvai
sayIt: bhoot pi-SAACH ni-KUT na-heen AA-vai / ma-haa-BEER jub naam su-NAA-vai
translation: Ghosts and evil spirits do not come near when one calls out the name of Mahavira, the great hero.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 24, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: What name or truth do you reach for out loud when fear comes close?

translations.hi: जब कोई महावीर का नाम पुकारता है, तो भूत-पिशाच पास नहीं आते।

devanagari: नासै रोग हरै सब पीरा । / जपत निरंतर हनुमत बीरा
iast: nāsai roga harai saba pīrā । / japata niraṃtara hanumata bīrā
sayIt: NAA-sai rog ha-RAI sub PEE-raa / JA-pat ni-RUN-tar HA-nu-mat BEE-raa
translation: Disease is destroyed and every pain is lifted for one who constantly repeats the name of brave Hanuman.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 25, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: What small practice could you repeat steadily enough that pain no longer fills the whole room?

translations.hi: जो निरंतर वीर हनुमान का जप करता है, उसके रोग नष्ट होते हैं और सारी पीड़ा हर ली जाती है।

devanagari: संकट तें हनुमान छुड़ावै । / मन क्रम बचन ध्यान जो लावै
iast: saṃkaṭa teṃ hanumāna chuḍāvai । / mana krama bacana dhyāna jo lāvai
sayIt: SUN-kut tayn ha-nu-MAAN chhu-DAA-vai / mun krum BA-chan DHYAAN jo LAA-vai
translation: Hanuman releases from distress whoever turns attention to him in thought, deed, and word.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 26, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: Are your thoughts, words, and actions asking for the same thing today?

translations.hi: जो मन, कर्म और वचन से हनुमान का ध्यान लगाता है, उसे वे संकट से छुड़ा लेते हैं।

devanagari: सब पर राम तपस्वी राजा । / तिन के काज सकल तुम साजा
iast: saba para rāma tapasvī rājā । / tina ke kāja sakala tuma sājā
sayIt: sub pur RAAM ta-PUS-vee RAA-jaa / tin kay kaaj sa-KUL tum SAA-jaa
translation: Over all reigns Rama, the ascetic king — and it was you who accomplished all of his tasks.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 27, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: Whose work are your abilities serving right now — and is it worthy of them?

translations.hi: सबके ऊपर तपस्वी राजा राम हैं — और उनके सारे काम तुमने ही सँवारे।

devanagari: और मनोरथ जो कोई लावै । / सोई अमित जीवन फल पावै
iast: aura manoratha jo koī lāvai । / soī amita jīvana phala pāvai
sayIt: aur ma-no-RUTH jo ko-EE LAA-vai / so-EE a-MIT JEE-van phul PAA-vai
translation: And whoever brings any heart's desire to you receives the boundless fruit of life itself.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 28, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: What longing would you name honestly today if you trusted it would be heard without judgement?

translations.hi: और जो कोई अपनी मनोकामना तुम्हारे पास लाता है, वह जीवन का असीम फल पाता है।

devanagari: चारों जुग परताप तुम्हारा । / है परसिद्ध जगत उजियारा
iast: cāroṃ juga paratāpa tumhārā । / hai parasiddha jagata ujiyārā
sayIt: CHAA-ro joog pur-TAAP tum-HAA-raa / hai pur-SIDH ja-GUT u-ji-YAA-raa
translation: Your glory endures through all four ages; your fame is renowned, a light upon the world.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 29, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: What are you building that could still give light when you are no longer in the room?

translations.hi: चारों युगों में तुम्हारा प्रताप है; तुम्हारी कीर्ति जगत में प्रसिद्ध है और उजियारा फैलाती है।

devanagari: साधु संत के तुम रखवारे । / असुर निकंदन राम दुलारे
iast: sādhu saṃta ke tuma rakhavāre । / asura nikaṃdana rāma dulāre
sayIt: SAA-dhoo sunt kay tum rakh-WAA-ray / a-SOOR ni-KUN-dun raam du-LAA-ray
translation: You are the guardian of sadhus and saints, the destroyer of demons, the beloved of Rama.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 30, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: Who around you needs guarding today, and what would it cost you to stand watch?

translations.hi: तुम साधु-संतों के रखवाले हो, असुरों का नाश करने वाले और राम के दुलारे हो।

devanagari: अष्ट सिद्धि नौ निधि के दाता । / अस बर दीन जानकी माता
iast: aṣṭa siddhi nau nidhi ke dātā । / asa bara dīna jānakī mātā
sayIt: USHT SID-dhi nau NI-dhi kay DAA-taa / us bur DEEN JAA-na-kee MAA-taa
translation: You are the giver of the eight siddhis and the nine nidhis — such is the boon Mother Janaki granted you.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 31, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: If real power landed in your hands today, who would you use it for first?

translations.hi: तुम आठ सिद्धियों और नौ निधियों के दाता हो — ऐसा वरदान माता जानकी ने तुम्हें दिया।

devanagari: राम रसायन तुम्हरे पासा । / सदा रहो रघुपति के दासा
iast: rāma rasāyana tumhare pāsā । / sadā raho raghupati ke dāsā
sayIt: raam ra-SAA-yun TUM-ha-ray PAA-saa / sa-DAA ra-ho ra-ghu-PA-ti kay DAA-saa
translation: You hold the elixir of Rama's name; may you remain forever the servant of Raghupati.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 32, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: What do you keep closest and return to daily — and does it actually restore you?

translations.hi: राम-नाम का रसायन तुम्हारे पास है; तुम सदा रघुपति के दास बने रहो।

devanagari: तुम्हरे भजन राम को पावै । / जनम जनम के दुख बिसरावै
iast: tumhare bhajana rāma ko pāvai । / janama janama ke dukha bisarāvai
sayIt: TUM-ha-ray BHA-jun raam ko PAA-vai / JA-num JA-num kay dookh bi-sa-RAA-vai
translation: Through singing your praise one reaches Rama, and the sorrows of birth after birth are forgotten.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 33, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: What sorrow are you ready to stop rehearsing, year after year?

translations.hi: तुम्हारे भजन से राम मिल जाते हैं, और जन्म-जन्म के दुख भूल जाते हैं।

devanagari: अंत काल रघुबर पुर जाई । / जहाँ जन्म हरिभक्त कहाई
iast: aṃta kāla raghubara pura jāī । / jahām̐ janma haribhakta kahāī
sayIt: unt kaal ra-ghu-BUR poor JAA-ee / ja-HAAN junm ha-ri-BHUKT ka-HAA-ee
translation: At life's end such a devotee goes to the city of Raghubara; and wherever born again, is known as Hari's devotee.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 34, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: If only your deepest loyalty outlives you, what does today's schedule say that loyalty is?

translations.hi: अंत समय में ऐसा भक्त रघुवर के धाम जाता है; और जहाँ भी जन्म ले, हरिभक्त कहलाता है।

devanagari: और देवता चित्त न धरई । / हनुमत सेई सर्ब सुख करई
iast: aura devatā citta na dharaī । / hanumata seī sarba sukha karaī
sayIt: aur DAY-va-taa chitt na dha-RA-ee / HA-nu-mut say-EE surb sookh ka-RA-ee
translation: Even one who holds no other deity in mind finds that serving Hanuman brings every happiness.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 35, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: Where is your attention scattered across many doors when one deep commitment would carry you further?

translations.hi: और किसी देवता को चित्त में न भी धरे, तो भी हनुमान की सेवा से सब सुख मिल जाते हैं।

devanagari: संकट कटै मिटै सब पीरा । / जो सुमिरै हनुमत बलबीरा
iast: saṃkaṭa kaṭai miṭai saba pīrā । / jo sumirai hanumata balabīrā
sayIt: SUN-kut ka-TAI mi-TAI sub PEE-raa / jo su-mi-RAI HA-nu-mut bul-BEE-raa
translation: Distress is cut away and every pain erased for whoever remembers Hanuman, the mighty hero.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 36, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: What trouble shrinks the moment you remember you are not facing it alone?

translations.hi: जो बलवीर हनुमान का स्मरण करता है, उसके संकट कट जाते हैं और सारी पीड़ा मिट जाती है।

devanagari: जै जै जै हनुमान गोसाईं । / कृपा करहु गुरु देव की नाईं
iast: jai jai jai hanumāna gosāīṃ । / kṛpā karahu guru deva kī nāīṃ
sayIt: jai jai jai ha-nu-MAAN go-SAA-een / kri-PAA ka-ra-hoo GU-ru dayv kee NAA-een
translation: Victory, victory, victory to you, Lord Hanuman! Bestow your grace upon me as a guru does.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 37, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: Who has shaped you the way a true teacher does — and are you still willing to be taught?

translations.hi: हे स्वामी हनुमान, तुम्हारी जय हो, जय हो, जय हो! गुरुदेव की तरह मुझ पर कृपा करो।

devanagari: जो सत बार पाठ कर कोई । / छूटहि बंदि महा सुख होई
iast: jo sata bāra pāṭha kara koī । / chūṭahi baṃdi mahā sukha hoī
sayIt: jo sut baar paath kur ko-EE / CHHOO-ta-hi BUN-di ma-HAA sookh ho-EE
translation: Whoever recites this a hundred times is released from bondage, and great joy follows.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 38, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: What could a hundred honest repetitions of one practice free you from?

translations.hi: जो कोई इसका सौ बार पाठ करता है, वह बंधन से छूट जाता है और महासुख पाता है।

devanagari: जो यह पढ़ै हनुमान चलीसा । / होय सिद्धि साखी गौरीसा
iast: jo yaha paḍhai hanumāna calīsā । / hoya siddhi sākhī gaurīsā
sayIt: jo yeh pa-DHAI ha-nu-MAAN cha-LEE-saa / hoy SID-dhi SAA-khee gau-REE-saa
translation: Whoever reads this Hanuman Chalisa attains fulfilment — Gauri's lord, Shiva himself, is witness.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 39, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: What would you attempt with full effort if you believed it was truly witnessed?

translations.hi: जो यह हनुमान चालीसा पढ़ता है, उसे सिद्धि प्राप्त होती है — इसके साक्षी स्वयं गौरी के स्वामी शिव हैं।

devanagari: तुलसीदास सदा हरि चेरा । / कीजै नाथ हृदय महँ डेरा
iast: tulasīdāsa sadā hari cerā । / kījai nātha hṛdaya maham̐ ḍerā
sayIt: tul-see-DAAS sa-DAA ha-ri CHAY-raa / KEE-jai naath hri-DAY ma-hun DAY-raa
translation: Tulsidas is forever the servant of Hari; O Lord, make your dwelling in my heart.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 40, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: What would change if what you love most were not a visitor in your heart but a permanent resident?

translations.hi: तुलसीदास सदा हरि के दास हैं; हे नाथ, मेरे हृदय में अपना डेरा कीजिए।

devanagari: श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि । / बरनऊँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि
iast: śrīguru carana saroja raja nija manu mukuru sudhāri । / baranaūm̐ raghubara bimala jasu jo dāyaku phala cāri
sayIt: shree-GU-ru CHA-ra-na sa-RO-ja RA-ja NI-ja MA-nu MU-ku-ru su-DHAA-ri / ba-ra-na-OON ra-ghu-BA-ra BI-ma-la JA-su jo DAA-ya-ku PHA-la CHAA-ri
translation: Cleansing the mirror of my mind with the dust of my guru's lotus feet, I recount the spotless glory of Raghubara, giver of the four fruits of life.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, opening doha 1, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: Before you begin today's most important work, what would it mean to first polish the mirror of your mind?

translations.hi: श्रीगुरु के चरण-कमलों की धूल से अपने मन का दर्पण साफ़ करके, मैं रघुवर के निर्मल यश का वर्णन करता हूँ, जो जीवन के चारों फल देने वाला है।

devanagari: बुद्धिहीन तनु जानिके सुमिरौं पवनकुमार । / बल बुद्धि बिद्या देहु मोहिं हरहु कलेस बिकार
iast: buddhihīna tanu jānike sumirauṃ pavanakumāra । / bala buddhi bidyā dehu mohiṃ harahu kalesa bikāra
sayIt: bud-dhi-HEE-na TA-nu JAA-ni-kay su-mi-RAUN pa-va-na-ku-MAA-ra / BA-la BUD-dhi BID-yaa DAY-hu MO-hin HA-ra-hu ka-LAY-sa bi-KAA-ra
translation: Knowing myself to be poor in understanding, I remember the Son of the Wind: grant me strength, intelligence, and knowledge, and take away my afflictions and impurities.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, opening doha 2, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: What would you ask for today if you began by honestly admitting what you lack?

translations.hi: अपने आप को बुद्धिहीन जानकर मैं पवनकुमार का स्मरण करता हूँ: मुझे बल, बुद्धि और विद्या दीजिए, और मेरे क्लेश और विकार हर लीजिए।

devanagari: पवनतनय संकट हरन मंगल मूरति रूप । / राम लखन सीता सहित हृदय बसहु सुर भूप
iast: pavanatanaya saṃkaṭa harana maṃgala mūrati rūpa । / rāma lakhana sītā sahita hṛdaya basahu sura bhūpa
sayIt: PA-vun ta-NAY SUN-kut HA-run MUN-gul MOO-rut roop / raam LA-khun SEE-taa sa-HIT hri-DAY BA-sa-hoo soor BHOOP
translation: Son of the Wind, remover of distress, embodiment of blessing — with Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita, dwell in my heart, king among gods.
source: Hanuman Chalisa, closing doha, Tulsidas (Awadhi, public domain original), via sanskritdocuments.org, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_hanumaana/hanuman40.itx
reflection: If your heart were a home, who would be living in it right now?

translations.hi: हे पवनपुत्र, संकट हरने वाले, मंगलमूर्ति! राम, लखन और सीता सहित मेरे हृदय में निवास कीजिए, हे देवताओं में राजा।

devanagari: देहिनोऽस्मिन्यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा । / तथा देहान्तरप्राप्तिर्धीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति ॥2.13॥
iast: dehino'sminyathā dehe kaumāraṃ yauvanaṃ jarā । / tathā dehāntaraprāptirdhīrastatra na muhyati ॥2.13॥
sayIt: day-hi-NO-smin ya-THAA DAY-hay kow-MAA-ram YOW-va-nam ja-RAA / ta-THAA day-HAAN-ta-ra-PRAAP-tir DHEE-ras TA-tra na MUH-ya-ti
translation: Just as the embodied self passes through childhood, youth, and old age in this body, so at death it passes into another body; the wise person is not confused by this.
source: Bhagavad Gita 2.13, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%99%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%96%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: The body changes constantly — what in you has watched all of it change?

translations.hi: जैसे देहधारी आत्मा इसी देह में बचपन, यौवन और बुढ़ापे से गुज़रती है, वैसे ही मृत्यु पर वह दूसरी देह में प्रवेश करती है; धीर व्यक्ति इससे विचलित नहीं होता।
translations.bn: দেহধারী আত্মা যেমন এই দেহেই শৈশব, যৌবন ও জরার মধ্য দিয়ে যায়, তেমনই মৃত্যুতে সে অন্য দেহে প্রবেশ করে; ধীর ব্যক্তি এতে বিভ্রান্ত হন না।
translations.mr: ज्याप्रमाणे देहधारी आत्मा याच देहात बालपण, तारुण्य आणि म्हातारपण यांतून जातो, त्याचप्रमाणे मृत्यूनंतर तो दुसऱ्या देहात प्रवेश करतो; धीर माणूस याने गोंधळून जात नाही.
translations.ta: உடலெடுத்த ஆன்மா இந்த உடலிலேயே பால்யம், இளமை, முதுமை என்று கடந்து செல்வதுபோல், மரணத்தில் அது மற்றொரு உடலை அடைகிறது; தீரர் இதனால் மயங்குவதில்லை.
translations.gu: જેમ દેહધારી આત્મા આ જ દેહમાં બાળપણ, યુવાની અને ઘડપણમાંથી પસાર થાય છે, તેમ મૃત્યુ વખતે તે બીજા દેહમાં પ્રવેશે છે; ધીર માણસ આનાથી મૂંઝાતો નથી.

devanagari: मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः । / आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत ॥2.14॥
iast: mātrāsparśāstu kaunteya śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkhadāḥ । / āgamāpāyino'nityāstāṃstitikṣasva bhārata ॥2.14॥
sayIt: maa-traa-spar-SHAAS too kown-TAY-ya shee-TOSH-na-soo-kha-DUH-kha-daah / aa-ga-maa-PAA-yi-no NIT-yaas taans ti-TIK-shas-va BHAA-ra-ta
translation: Contacts between the senses and their objects, Arjuna, bring cold and heat, pleasure and pain. They come and go and do not last — endure them patiently, Bharata.
source: Bhagavad Gita 2.14, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%99%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%96%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What discomfort today can you meet as weather — passing, and bearable?

translations.hi: हे कौन्तेय, इंद्रियों का विषयों से स्पर्श ही सर्दी-गर्मी और सुख-दुख देता है। वे आते-जाते हैं, टिकते नहीं — हे भारत, उन्हें धैर्य से सहन कर।
translations.bn: হে কৌন্তেয়, ইন্দ্রিয়ের সঙ্গে বিষয়ের স্পর্শই শীত-গ্রীষ্ম আর সুখ-দুঃখ আনে। তারা আসে-যায়, স্থায়ী হয় না — হে ভারত, ধৈর্য ধরে তাদের সহ্য করো।
translations.mr: हे कौन्तेया, इंद्रियांचे विषयांशी होणारे स्पर्शच थंडी-ऊन आणि सुखदुःख देतात. ते येतात आणि जातात, टिकत नाहीत — हे भारता, ते धीराने सहन कर.
translations.ta: குந்தியின் மகனே, புலன்கள் தம் பொருள்களைத் தொடும் தொடர்புதான் குளிரையும் வெப்பத்தையும், இன்பத்தையும் துன்பத்தையும் தருகிறது. அவை வந்து போகின்றன, நிலைப்பதில்லை — பாரதா, அவற்றைப் பொறுமையுடன் தாங்கிக்கொள்.
translations.gu: હે કૌન્તેય, ઇન્દ્રિયોનો વિષયો સાથેનો સ્પર્શ જ ઠંડી-ગરમી અને સુખ-દુઃખ આપે છે. તે આવે છે ને જાય છે, ટકતાં નથી — હે ભારત, તેમને ધીરજથી સહન કર.

devanagari: न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः । / अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे ॥2.20॥
iast: na jāyate mriyate vā kadācinnāyaṃ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ । / ajo nityaḥ śāśvato'yaṃ purāṇo na hanyate hanyamāne śarīre ॥2.20॥
sayIt: na JAA-ya-tay MRI-ya-tay vaa ka-DAA-chin NAA-yam BHOOT-vaa bha-vi-TAA vaa na BHOO-yah / a-JO NIT-yah SHAASH-va-TO-yam poo-RAA-no na HAN-ya-tay han-ya-MAA-nay sha-REE-ray
translation: The self is never born and never dies; having existed, it never ceases to be. Unborn, eternal, everlasting, and ancient, it is not slain when the body is slain.
source: Bhagavad Gita 2.20, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%99%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%96%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: If the deepest part of you cannot be harmed, what would you attempt?

translations.hi: आत्मा न कभी जन्म लेती है, न मरती है; एक बार होकर वह फिर कभी होना बंद नहीं करती। अजन्मी, नित्य, शाश्वत और पुरातन यह आत्मा शरीर के मारे जाने पर नहीं मरती।
translations.bn: আত্মা কখনও জন্মায় না, মরেও না; একবার থেকে সে আর কখনও না-থাকা হয়ে যায় না। অজ, নিত্য, শাশ্বত ও পুরাতন এই আত্মা দেহ নিহত হলেও নিহত হয় না।
translations.mr: आत्मा कधी जन्मत नाही आणि कधी मरत नाही; एकदा असल्यावर तो पुन्हा कधी असणे थांबवत नाही. अजन्मा, नित्य, शाश्वत आणि पुरातन असा हा आत्मा, शरीर मारले गेले तरी मरत नाही.
translations.ta: ஆன்மா ஒருபோதும் பிறப்பதில்லை, இறப்பதில்லை; ஒருமுறை இருந்துவிட்டு, பிறகு இல்லாமல் போவதுமில்லை. பிறப்பற்றது, நித்தியமானது, என்றும் நிலைப்பது, தொன்மையானது — உடல் கொல்லப்படும்போது அது கொல்லப்படுவதில்லை.
translations.gu: આત્મા ન ક્યારેય જન્મે છે, ન મરે છે; એક વાર હોઈને તે ફરી ક્યારેય હોવાનું બંધ કરતો નથી. અજન્મા, નિત્ય, શાશ્વત અને પુરાતન એવો આ આત્મા, શરીર હણાય ત્યારે હણાતો નથી.

devanagari: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन । / मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ॥2.47॥
iast: karmaṇyevādhikāraste mā phaleṣu kadācana । / mā karmaphalaheturbhūrmā te saṅgo'stvakarmaṇi ॥2.47॥
sayIt: kar-mun-YAY-vah-dhi-KAA-ras-tay maa pha-LAY-shoo ka-DAA-cha-na / maa kar-ma-pha-la-HAY-toor-bhoor maa tay SUN-go-stva-KAR-ma-ni
translation: Your right is to the action alone, never to its results. Do not make the results of action your motive, and do not become attached to inaction.
source: Bhagavad Gita 2.47, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%99%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%96%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What task today deserves your full effort — with the outcome released?

translations.hi: तेरा अधिकार केवल कर्म पर है, उसके फलों पर कभी नहीं। कर्म के फल को अपना मक़सद मत बना, और अकर्म से भी तेरा लगाव न हो।
translations.bn: কর্মেই তোমার অধিকার, তার ফলে কখনও নয়। কর্মের ফলকে নিজের প্রেরণা কোরো না, আবার অকর্মেও তোমার আসক্তি না হোক।
translations.mr: तुझा अधिकार केवळ कर्मावर आहे, त्याच्या फळांवर कधीही नाही. कर्माच्या फळांना आपला हेतू बनवू नकोस, आणि अकर्माशीही तुझी आसक्ती नसो.
translations.ta: செயலில் மட்டுமே உனக்கு உரிமை; அதன் பலன்களில் ஒருபோதும் இல்லை. செயலின் பலன்களை உன் நோக்கமாக்காதே; செயலின்மையிலும் உனக்குப் பற்று வேண்டாம்.
translations.gu: તારો અધિકાર ફક્ત કર્મ પર છે, તેનાં ફળ પર ક્યારેય નહીં. કર્મનાં ફળને તારો હેતુ ન બનાવ, અને અકર્મમાં પણ તારી આસક્તિ ન હો.

devanagari: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनंजय । / सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते ॥2.48॥
iast: yogasthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā dhanaṃjaya । / siddhyasiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṃ yoga ucyate ॥2.48॥
sayIt: yo-GAS-thah KOO-roo kar-MAA-ni SUN-gam TYAKT-vaa dha-nan-JA-ya / sid-dhya-SID-dhyoh sa-MO BHOOT-vaa sa-MAT-vam YO-ga OOCH-ya-tay
translation: Established in yoga, do your work, Arjuna, letting go of attachment, staying even in success and failure. That evenness of mind is called yoga.
source: Bhagavad Gita 2.48, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%99%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%96%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What would evenness look like in your hardest hour today?

translations.hi: हे धनंजय, योग में स्थित होकर, आसक्ति त्यागकर, सिद्धि और असिद्धि में सम रहते हुए अपने कर्म कर। यही समता योग कहलाती है।
translations.bn: হে ধনঞ্জয়, যোগে স্থিত হয়ে, আসক্তি ত্যাগ করে, সিদ্ধি ও অসিদ্ধিতে সমান থেকে তোমার কর্ম করো। মনের সেই সমতাই যোগ নামে পরিচিত।
translations.mr: हे धनंजया, योगात स्थिर राहून, आसक्ती सोडून, सिद्धी आणि असिद्धी यांत सम राहून आपली कर्मे कर. हीच समता योग म्हटली जाते.
translations.ta: தனஞ்சயா, யோகத்தில் நிலைத்து நின்று, பற்றைத் துறந்து, வெற்றியிலும் தோல்வியிலும் சமமாக இருந்து உன் செயல்களைச் செய். அந்தச் சமநிலையே யோகம் எனப்படுகிறது.
translations.gu: હે ધનંજય, યોગમાં સ્થિત થઈને, આસક્તિ છોડીને, સિદ્ધિ અને અસિદ્ધિમાં સમ રહીને તારાં કર્મ કર. મનની એ સમતા જ યોગ કહેવાય છે.

devanagari: ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते । / सङ्गात्संजायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते ॥2.62॥
iast: dhyāyato viṣayānpuṃsaḥ saṅgasteṣūpajāyate । / saṅgātsaṃjāyate kāmaḥ kāmātkrodho'bhijāyate ॥2.62॥
sayIt: DHYAA-ya-to vi-sha-YAAN POOM-sah SUN-gas tay-SHOO-pa-JAA-ya-tay / sun-GAAT san-JAA-ya-tay KAA-mah kaa-MAAT KRO-dho-bhi-JAA-ya-tay
translation: When a person keeps dwelling on the objects of the senses, attachment to them arises; from attachment desire is born, and from desire anger arises.
source: Bhagavad Gita 2.62, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%99%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%96%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What do you keep returning to in thought — and where is it leading you?

translations.hi: विषयों का चिंतन करते रहने वाले व्यक्ति में उनके प्रति आसक्ति पैदा होती है; आसक्ति से कामना जन्म लेती है, और कामना से क्रोध उपजता है।
translations.bn: যে মানুষ ইন্দ্রিয়ের বিষয় নিয়ে ভেবে চলে, তার মধ্যে সেগুলির প্রতি আসক্তি জন্মায়; আসক্তি থেকে জন্ম নেয় কামনা, আর কামনা থেকে জাগে ক্রোধ।
translations.mr: विषयांचे चिंतन करत राहणाऱ्या माणसात त्यांच्याविषयी आसक्ती निर्माण होते; आसक्तीतून कामना जन्मते, आणि कामनेतून क्रोध उपजतो.
translations.ta: புலன் விஷயங்களையே எண்ணிக்கொண்டிருப்பவரிடம் அவற்றின் மீது பற்று எழுகிறது; பற்றிலிருந்து விருப்பம் பிறக்கிறது; விருப்பத்திலிருந்து சினம் எழுகிறது.
translations.gu: વિષયોનું ચિંતન કરતા રહેનાર માણસમાં તેમના પ્રત્યે આસક્તિ જન્મે છે; આસક્તિમાંથી કામના જન્મે છે, અને કામનામાંથી ક્રોધ ઊપજે છે.

devanagari: क्रोधाद्भवति संमोहः संमोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः । / स्मृतिभ्रंशाद्बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति ॥2.63॥
iast: krodhādbhavati saṃmohaḥ saṃmohātsmṛtivibhramaḥ । / smṛtibhraṃśādbuddhināśo buddhināśātpraṇaśyati ॥2.63॥
sayIt: kro-DHAAD BHA-va-ti sam-MO-hah sam-mo-HAAT smri-ti-vi-BHRA-mah / smri-ti-bhran-SHAAD bood-dhi-NAA-sho bood-dhi-naa-SHAAT pra-NASH-ya-ti
translation: From anger comes delusion; from delusion, confusion of memory; from confusion of memory, the loss of discernment; and when discernment is lost, a person is ruined.
source: Bhagavad Gita 2.63, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%99%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%96%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: When anger last clouded you, what did you stop seeing?

translations.hi: क्रोध से मोह पैदा होता है; मोह से स्मृति का भ्रम; स्मृति के भ्रम से बुद्धि का नाश; और बुद्धि के नाश से मनुष्य नष्ट हो जाता है।
translations.bn: ক্রোধ থেকে আসে মোহ; মোহ থেকে স্মৃতির বিভ্রম; স্মৃতির বিভ্রম থেকে বুদ্ধিনাশ; আর বুদ্ধি নষ্ট হলে মানুষ ধ্বংস হয়ে যায়।
translations.mr: क्रोधातून मोह निर्माण होतो; मोहातून स्मृतीचा भ्रम; स्मृतीच्या भ्रमातून बुद्धीचा नाश; आणि बुद्धीचा नाश झाला की माणूस नष्ट होतो.
translations.ta: சினத்திலிருந்து மயக்கம் வருகிறது; மயக்கத்திலிருந்து நினைவின் குழப்பம்; நினைவு குலைவதால் பகுத்தறிவின் அழிவு; பகுத்தறிவு அழிந்ததும் மனிதன் அழிகிறான்.
translations.gu: ક્રોધમાંથી મોહ જન્મે છે; મોહમાંથી સ્મૃતિનો ભ્રમ; સ્મૃતિના ભ્રમમાંથી બુદ્ધિનો નાશ; અને બુદ્ધિનો નાશ થતાં માણસ નષ્ટ થઈ જાય છે.

devanagari: या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी । / यस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः ॥2.69॥
iast: yā niśā sarvabhūtānāṃ tasyāṃ jāgarti saṃyamī । / yasyāṃ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśā paśyato muneḥ ॥2.69॥
sayIt: yaa ni-SHAA sar-va-bhoo-TAA-naam TAS-yaam JAA-gar-ti san-ya-MEE / YAS-yaam JAA-gra-ti bhoo-TAA-ni saa ni-SHAA PASH-ya-to moo-NAYH
translation: What is night for all beings is when the self-controlled one is awake; and what beings are awake in, the seeing sage knows as night.
source: Bhagavad Gita 2.69, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%99%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%96%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What matters to you that the world around you barely notices?

translations.hi: जो सब प्राणियों के लिए रात है, उसमें संयमी जागता है; और जिसमें प्राणी जागते हैं, देखने वाले मुनि के लिए वही रात है।
translations.bn: যা সব প্রাণীর কাছে রাত্রি, সংযমী সেখানেই জেগে থাকেন; আর যাতে প্রাণীরা জেগে থাকে, দ্রষ্টা মুনির কাছে সেটিই রাত্রি।
translations.mr: जी सर्व प्राण्यांसाठी रात्र आहे, तिच्यात संयमी जागा असतो; आणि ज्यात प्राणी जागे असतात, ती पाहणाऱ्या मुनीसाठी रात्र आहे.
translations.ta: எல்லா உயிர்களுக்கும் இரவாக இருப்பதில் தன்னடக்கம் உள்ளவர் விழித்திருக்கிறார்; உயிர்கள் எதில் விழித்திருக்கின்றனவோ, அதுவே காணும் முனிவருக்கு இரவு.
translations.gu: જે સર્વ પ્રાણીઓ માટે રાત છે, તેમાં સંયમી જાગે છે; અને જેમાં પ્રાણીઓ જાગે છે, તે જોનાર મુનિ માટે રાત છે.

devanagari: आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत् । / तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी ॥2.70॥
iast: āpūryamāṇamacalapratiṣṭhaṃ samudramāpaḥ praviśanti yadvat । / tadvatkāmā yaṃ praviśanti sarve sa śāntimāpnoti na kāmakāmī ॥2.70॥
sayIt: aa-poor-ya-MAA-nam a-cha-la-pra-TISH-tham sa-moo-DRAM AA-pah pra-vi-SHAN-ti YAD-vat / TAD-vat KAA-maa yam pra-vi-SHAN-ti SAR-vay sa SHAAN-tim aap-NO-ti na kaa-ma-KAA-mee
translation: As waters flow into the ocean, which stays full and unmoved as they enter, so all desires enter the one who attains peace — not the one who runs after desires.
source: Bhagavad Gita 2.70, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%99%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%96%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What desire could you let arrive — and pass — without chasing it today?

translations.hi: जैसे जल की धाराएँ समुद्र में मिलती जाती हैं और वह भरता हुआ भी अचल बना रहता है, वैसे ही जिसमें सारी कामनाएँ समा जाती हैं वही शांति पाता है — कामनाओं के पीछे भागने वाला नहीं।
translations.bn: জলধারা যেমন সমুদ্রে এসে মেশে, আর সমুদ্র ভরতে ভরতেও অটল থাকে, তেমনই যাঁর মধ্যে সব কামনা এসে মিশে যায় তিনিই শান্তি পান — কামনার পিছনে ছুটে চলা মানুষ নয়।
translations.mr: जसे पाणी समुद्रात शिरत राहते आणि तो भरत असूनही अचल राहतो, तशा साऱ्या कामना ज्याच्यात सामावून जातात तोच शांती पावतो — कामनांच्या मागे धावणारा नव्हे.
translations.ta: நீர்த்தாரைகள் கடலில் புகுந்தாலும் அது நிறைந்தும் அசையாமலும் இருப்பதுபோல், எவருள் எல்லா விருப்பங்களும் புகுந்து அடங்குகின்றனவோ, அவரே அமைதி அடைகிறார் — விருப்பங்களின் பின் ஓடுபவர் அல்ல.
translations.gu: જેમ જળધારાઓ સમુદ્રમાં પ્રવેશતી રહે છે અને તે ભરાતો છતાં અચળ રહે છે, તેમ જેનામાં સર્વ કામનાઓ સમાઈ જાય છે તે જ શાંતિ પામે છે — કામનાઓની પાછળ દોડનાર નહીં.

devanagari: विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान् पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः । / निर्ममो निरहंकारः स शान्तिमधिगच्छति ॥2.71॥
iast: vihāya kāmānyaḥ sarvān pumāṃścarati niḥspṛhaḥ । / nirmamo nirahaṃkāraḥ sa śāntimadhigacchati ॥2.71॥
sayIt: vi-HAA-ya kaa-MAAN yah sar-VAAN poo-MAANSH cha-ra-ti nih-SPRI-hah / nir-ma-MO ni-ra-hun-KAA-rah sa SHAAN-tim a-dhi-GACH-cha-ti
translation: The person who abandons all desires and moves through life free of craving, without any sense of "mine" or "I", attains peace.
source: Bhagavad Gita 2.71, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%99%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%96%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What one claim of "mine" feels heaviest right now?

translations.hi: जो व्यक्ति सारी कामनाएँ त्यागकर, लालसा से मुक्त होकर, "मेरा" और "मैं" के भाव के बिना जीवन में चलता है, वही शांति पाता है।
translations.bn: যে মানুষ সব কামনা ছেড়ে, তৃষ্ণামুক্ত হয়ে, "আমার" বা "আমি"-র বোধ ছাড়া জীবনে চলেন, তিনিই শান্তি পান।
translations.mr: जो माणूस साऱ्या कामना सोडून, हावेपासून मुक्त होऊन, "माझे" आणि "मी" या भावांशिवाय जीवनात वावरतो, त्यालाच शांती मिळते.
translations.ta: எல்லா விருப்பங்களையும் விட்டுவிட்டு, ஏக்கமின்றி, "எனது" என்ற பற்றும் "நான்" என்ற செருக்கும் இல்லாமல் வாழ்வில் நடக்கும் மனிதரே அமைதி அடைகிறார்.
translations.gu: જે માણસ સર્વ કામનાઓ છોડીને, તૃષ્ણા વિના, "મારું" કે "હું"ના ભાવ વગર જીવનમાં ચાલે છે, તે જ શાંતિ પામે છે.

devanagari: न कर्मणामनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते । / न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति ॥3.4॥
iast: na karmaṇāmanārambhānnaiṣkarmyaṃ puruṣo'śnute । / na ca saṃnyasanādeva siddhiṃ samadhigacchati ॥3.4॥
sayIt: na kar-ma-NAAM a-naa-RUM-bhaan naish-KAR-myum poo-roo-SHOSH-noo-tay / na cha sun-nya-sa-NAA-day-va SID-dhim sa-ma-dhi-GUCH-cha-ti
translation: Not by refusing to begin work does a person reach freedom from action, and not by renunciation alone does anyone arrive at perfection.
source: Bhagavad Gita 3.4, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Where in your life are you calling avoidance "detachment" — and what would rightly-done action look like there instead?

translations.hi: कर्मों को शुरू ही न करने से मनुष्य नैष्कर्म्य — कर्म से मुक्ति — नहीं पा लेता, और केवल संन्यास ले लेने भर से भी कोई सिद्धि तक नहीं पहुँचता।

devanagari: नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः । / शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः ॥3.8॥
iast: niyataṃ kuru karma tvaṃ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ । / śarīrayātrāpi ca te na prasiddhyedakarmaṇaḥ ॥3.8॥
sayIt: ni-ya-TUM KOO-roo KAR-ma tvum KAR-ma JYAA-yo hya-KAR-ma-nah / sha-REE-ra-YAA-traa-pi cha tay na pra-SID-dhyay-da-KAR-ma-nah
translation: Do the work that is yours to do, for action is better than inaction; without action, even keeping your body going would be impossible.
source: Bhagavad Gita 3.8, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What is the one piece of work that is genuinely yours today, and what substitute activity are you tempted to do instead?

translations.hi: जो कर्म तुम्हारे हिस्से का है, उसे करो, क्योंकि कर्म अकर्म से बेहतर है; बिना कर्म के तो तुम्हारे शरीर का निर्वाह भी संभव नहीं होगा।

devanagari: यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः । / तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसङ्गः समाचर ॥3.9॥
iast: yajñārthātkarmaṇo'nyatra loko'yaṃ karmabandhanaḥ । / tadarthaṃ karma kaunteya muktasaṅgaḥ samācara ॥3.9॥
sayIt: yug-YAAR-thaat kar-ma-NO-nya-tra lo-KO-yum KAR-ma-BUN-dha-nah / ta-DAR-thum KAR-ma kaun-TAY-ya mook-ta-SUN-gah sa-MAA-cha-ra
translation: Except for action done as sacrifice, this world is bound by action; so act for that purpose, son of Kunti, free from attachment.
source: Bhagavad Gita 3.9, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Which ordinary task today could you perform as an offering rather than a transaction?

translations.hi: यज्ञ के लिए किए गए कर्म को छोड़कर यह संसार कर्म से बँधा हुआ है; इसलिए हे कुन्तीपुत्र, आसक्ति से मुक्त होकर उसी उद्देश्य से कर्म करो।

devanagari: एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः । / अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति ॥3.16॥
iast: evaṃ pravartitaṃ cakraṃ nānuvartayatīha yaḥ । / aghāyurindriyārāmo moghaṃ pārtha sa jīvati ॥3.16॥
sayIt: AY-vum pra-var-TI-tum CHUK-rum naa-noo-var-ta-ya-TEE-ha yah / a-GHAA-yoor in-dri-YAA-raa-mo MO-ghum PAAR-tha sa JEE-va-ti
translation: One who does not help turn the wheel thus set in motion — living wrongly, absorbed in the senses — lives in vain, Partha.
source: Bhagavad Gita 3.16, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Where are you drawing from the wheel — family, community, nature — without putting anything back?

translations.hi: इस तरह चलाए गए चक्र को जो आगे नहीं चलाता — पाप में जीता हुआ, इन्द्रियों में रमा हुआ — हे पार्थ, वह व्यर्थ जीता है।

devanagari: तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर । / असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः ॥3.19॥
iast: tasmādasaktaḥ satataṃ kāryaṃ karma samācara । / asakto hyācarankarma paramāpnoti pūruṣaḥ ॥3.19॥
sayIt: tas-MAA-da-SUK-tah sa-ta-TUM KAAR-yum KAR-ma sa-MAA-cha-ra / a-SUK-to hyaa-cha-run KAR-ma pa-ra-MAAP-no-ti POO-roo-shah
translation: Therefore, always do the work that must be done, without attachment; for by acting unattached a person reaches the highest.
source: Bhagavad Gita 3.19, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What must be done today that you could practise doing fully — and holding lightly?

translations.hi: इसलिए जो कर्म करने योग्य है, उसे सदा अनासक्त होकर करते रहो; क्योंकि अनासक्त होकर कर्म करता हुआ मनुष्य परम को पा लेता है।

devanagari: यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः । / स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते ॥3.21॥
iast: yadyadācarati śreṣṭhastattadevetaro janaḥ । / sa yatpramāṇaṃ kurute lokastadanuvartate ॥3.21॥
sayIt: yud-ya-DAA-cha-ra-ti SHRAYSH-thus tat-ta-DAY-vay-ta-ro ja-nah / sa yat pra-MAA-num koo-roo-tay LO-kas ta-da-noo-VAR-ta-tay
translation: Whatever a great person does, other people do the same; whatever standard such a person sets, the world follows.
source: Bhagavad Gita 3.21, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Who quietly takes their standard from you, and what did your conduct teach them today?

translations.hi: श्रेष्ठ व्यक्ति जो-जो करता है, दूसरे लोग वही करते हैं; वह जो मानक स्थापित करता है, संसार उसी का अनुसरण करता है।

devanagari: सक्ताः कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत । / कुर्याद्विद्वांस्तथासक्तश्चिकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम् ॥3.25॥
iast: saktāḥ karmaṇyavidvāṃso yathā kurvanti bhārata । / kuryādvidvāṃstathāsaktaścikīrṣurlokasaṃgraham ॥3.25॥
sayIt: suk-TAAH kar-mun-ya-vid-VAAM-so ya-THAA koor-VUN-ti BHAA-ra-ta / koor-YAAD vid-VAAMS ta-THAA-suk-tush chi-KEER-shoor LO-ka-SUN-gra-hum
translation: As the unwise act, attached to their work, Bharata, so should the wise act — unattached, wishing to hold the world together.
source: Bhagavad Gita 3.25, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: If you kept today's effort exactly the same but changed the motive from personal gain to the good of those around you, what would shift?

translations.hi: हे भारत, जैसे अज्ञानी अपने कर्म में आसक्त होकर कर्म करते हैं, वैसे ही ज्ञानी को अनासक्त होकर, लोकसंग्रह की इच्छा से कर्म करना चाहिए।

devanagari: प्रकृतेः क्रियमाणानि गुणैः कर्माणि सर्वशः । / अहंकारविमूढात्मा कर्ताहमिति मन्यते ॥3.27॥
iast: prakṛteḥ kriyamāṇāni guṇaiḥ karmāṇi sarvaśaḥ । / ahaṃkāravimūḍhātmā kartāhamiti manyate ॥3.27॥
sayIt: pra-kri-TAYH kri-ya-MAA-naa-ni goo-NYE-hee kar-MAA-ni sar-va-SHAH / a-hung-KAA-ra-vi-MOO-dhaat-maa kar-TAA-ha-mi-ti MUN-ya-tay
translation: All actions are carried out by the gunas of nature; one whose mind is deluded by ego thinks, "I am the doer."
source: Bhagavad Gita 3.27, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Think of something you are proud of or ashamed of from this week — how much of it was truly "you," and how much was nature moving through you?

translations.hi: सारे कर्म प्रकृति के गुणों द्वारा ही किए जाते हैं; अहंकार से मोहित मन वाला व्यक्ति समझता है, "कर्ता मैं हूँ।"

devanagari: मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा । / निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः ॥3.30॥
iast: mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi saṃnyasyādhyātmacetasā । / nirāśīrnirmamo bhūtvā yudhyasva vigatajvaraḥ ॥3.30॥
sayIt: MA-yi sar-VAA-ni kar-MAA-ni sun-nyas-YAA-dhyaat-ma-CHAY-ta-saa / ni-RAA-sheer NEER-ma-mo BHOOT-vaa YOO-dhyas-va vi-ga-ta-JVA-rah
translation: Surrendering all actions to me, with mind resting in the Self, free of craving and possessiveness, fight — with the fever gone.
source: Bhagavad Gita 3.30, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What battle are you facing with a fever of anxiety — and what would it mean to offer it up before you fight it?

translations.hi: सारे कर्म मुझे समर्पित करके, मन को अध्यात्म में टिकाकर, कामना और ममता से मुक्त होकर, ज्वर छोड़कर युद्ध करो।

devanagari: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् । / स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः ॥3.35॥
iast: śreyānsvadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmātsvanuṣṭhitāt । / svadharme nidhanaṃ śreyaḥ paradharmo bhayāvahaḥ ॥3.35॥
sayIt: SHRAY-yaan sva-DHAR-mo vi-goo-NAH pa-ra-dhar-MAAT sva-noosh-thi-TAAT / sva-DHAR-may ni-dha-NUM SHRAY-yah pa-ra-DHAR-mo bha-YAA-va-hah
translation: Better your own dharma done imperfectly than another's dharma done well; better to die in your own dharma — another's dharma invites danger.
source: Bhagavad Gita 3.35, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Whose path have you been envying — and what would it look like to fully commit to your own imperfect one today?

translations.hi: अच्छी तरह निभाए गए पराए धर्म से अपना अधूरा धर्म बेहतर है; अपने धर्म में मृत्यु भी श्रेयस्कर है — पराया धर्म भय लेकर आता है।

devanagari: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत । / अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ॥4.7॥
iast: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata । / abhyutthānamadharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmyaham ॥4.7॥
sayIt: ya-DAA ya-DAA hi DHAR-mas-ya GLAA-nir BHA-va-ti BHAA-ra-ta / abh-yoot-THAA-nam a-DHAR-mas-ya ta-DAAT-maa-nam sri-JAAM-ya-ham
translation: Whenever dharma declines and adharma rises, O Bharata, then I bring myself forth.
source: Bhagavad Gita 4.7, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%9C%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%9E%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%A8%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Where in your life is something quietly declining that is waiting for you to show up?

translations.hi: हे भारत, जब-जब धर्म की हानि होती है और अधर्म का उभार होता है, तब-तब मैं स्वयं को प्रकट करता हूँ।

devanagari: परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम् । / धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे ॥4.8॥
iast: paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṃ vināśāya ca duṣkṛtām । / dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge ॥4.8॥
sayIt: pa-ri-TRAA-naa-ya saa-DHOO-naam vi-NAA-shaa-ya cha doosh-kri-TAAM / dhar-ma-sam-sthaa-pa-NAAR-thaa-ya sam-bha-VAA-mi yoo-GAY yoo-GAY
translation: To protect the good, to destroy evildoers, and to firmly establish dharma, I come into being age after age.
source: Bhagavad Gita 4.8, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%9C%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%9E%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%A8%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Which of the three — protecting the good, stopping a harm, steadying dharma — does today ask of you?

translations.hi: सज्जनों की रक्षा के लिए, दुष्कर्मियों के विनाश के लिए और धर्म की सुदृढ़ स्थापना के लिए मैं युग-युग में जन्म लेता हूँ।

devanagari: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम् । / मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः ॥4.11॥
iast: ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham । / mama vartmānuvartante manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ ॥4.11॥
sayIt: yay ya-THAA maam pra-PAD-yan-tay taams ta-THAI-va bha-JAAM-ya-ham / MA-ma vart-MAA-noo-var-TAN-tay ma-NOOSH-yaah PAAR-tha SAR-va-shah
translation: In whatever way people approach me, in that very way I receive them; all humans, O Partha, follow my path in every way.
source: Bhagavad Gita 4.11, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%9C%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%9E%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%A8%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: If the divine meets you exactly as you approach — how are you approaching today?

translations.hi: लोग जिस भाव से मेरी शरण में आते हैं, मैं उन्हें उसी भाव से अपनाता हूँ; हे पार्थ, मनुष्य हर तरह से मेरे ही मार्ग का अनुसरण करते हैं।

devanagari: कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः । / स बुद्धिमान्मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत् ॥4.18॥
iast: karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśyedakarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ । / sa buddhimānmanuṣyeṣu sa yuktaḥ kṛtsnakarmakṛt ॥4.18॥
sayIt: kar-MUN-ya-KAR-ma yah PASH-yed a-KAR-ma-ni cha KAR-ma yah / sa bood-dhi-MAAN ma-noosh-YAY-shoo sa YOOK-tah krits-na-KAR-ma-krit
translation: One who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among humans; that one is a yogi who has accomplished all action.
source: Bhagavad Gita 4.18, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%9C%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%9E%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%A8%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Is there something you are calling patience or restraint that is actually a decision you are avoiding?

translations.hi: जो कर्म में अकर्म देखता है और अकर्म में कर्म, वह मनुष्यों में बुद्धिमान है; वही योगी है, जिसने सारे कर्म पूरे कर लिए।

devanagari: श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परन्तप । / सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते ॥4.33॥
iast: śreyāndravyamayādyajñājjñānayajñaḥ parantapa । / sarvaṃ karmākhilaṃ pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate ॥4.33॥
sayIt: SHRAY-yaan drav-ya-ma-YAAD yag-YAAJ gyaa-na-YAG-yah pa-ran-TA-pa / SAR-vam kar-MAA-khi-lam PAAR-tha GYAA-nay pa-ri-sa-MAAP-ya-tay
translation: Better than the sacrifice of material things is the sacrifice of knowledge, O scorcher of foes; all action without exception, O Partha, culminates in knowledge.
source: Bhagavad Gita 4.33, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%9C%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%9E%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%A8%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What is one routine you perform on autopilot that would change if you remembered why you do it?

translations.hi: हे परंतप, द्रव्यों से किए गए यज्ञ से ज्ञानयज्ञ श्रेष्ठ है; हे पार्थ, सारा कर्म बिना किसी अपवाद के ज्ञान में ही पूर्ण होता है।

devanagari: तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया । / उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः ॥4.34॥
iast: tadviddhi praṇipātena paripraśnena sevayā । / upadekṣyanti te jñānaṃ jñāninastattvadarśinaḥ ॥4.34॥
sayIt: tad-VID-dhi pra-ni-PAA-tay-na pa-ri-PRASH-nay-na SAY-va-yaa / oo-pa-DEK-shyan-ti tay GYAA-nam GYAA-ni-nas tat-tva-DAR-shi-nah
translation: Learn that knowledge by bowing, by sincere questioning, and by service; the wise who have seen the truth will teach it to you.
source: Bhagavad Gita 4.34, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%9C%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%9E%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%A8%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Whom do you trust enough to ask a real question — and when did you last actually ask one?

translations.hi: उस ज्ञान को प्रणाम से, सच्चे प्रश्न पूछने से और सेवा से सीखो; तत्त्व को देख चुके ज्ञानी तुम्हें उसका उपदेश देंगे।

devanagari: अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः । / सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि ॥4.36॥
iast: api cedasi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ । / sarvaṃ jñānaplavenaiva vṛjinaṃ santariṣyasi ॥4.36॥
sayIt: A-pi CHED a-si paa-PAY-bhyah sar-VAY-bhyah paa-pa-KRIT-ta-mah / SAR-vam gyaa-na-pla-VAY-nai-va vri-JI-nam san-ta-RISH-ya-si
translation: Even if you were the most sinful of all sinners, you would cross over all wrongdoing by the boat of knowledge alone.
source: Bhagavad Gita 4.36, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%9C%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%9E%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%A8%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What past mistake are you still treading water in, instead of building the understanding that would carry you across?

translations.hi: भले ही तुम सब पापियों में सबसे बड़े पापी होते, तब भी ज्ञान की नाव से ही तुम सारे पाप के पार उतर जाओगे।

devanagari: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते । / तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति ॥4.38॥
iast: na hi jñānena sadṛśaṃ pavitramiha vidyate । / tatsvayaṃ yogasaṃsiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati ॥4.38॥
sayIt: na hi gyaa-NAY-na sa-DRI-sham pa-VIT-ram i-ha VID-ya-tay / tat SVA-yam yo-ga-sam-SID-dhah kaa-LAY-naat-ma-ni VIN-da-ti
translation: Nothing in this world purifies like knowledge; one perfected through yoga finds it, in time, within oneself.
source: Bhagavad Gita 4.38, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%9C%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%9E%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%A8%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Where are you demanding instant clarity from a practice that is quietly working on its own schedule?

translations.hi: इस संसार में ज्ञान के समान पवित्र करने वाला कुछ नहीं है; योग में सिद्ध हुआ व्यक्ति उसे समय आने पर स्वयं अपने भीतर पा लेता है।

devanagari: श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः । / ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति ॥4.39॥
iast: śraddhāvām̐llabhate jñānaṃ tatparaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ । / jñānaṃ labdhvā parāṃ śāntimacireṇādhigacchati ॥4.39॥
sayIt: shrad-DHAA-vaan LA-bha-tay GYAA-nam TAT-pa-rah sam-ya-TEN-dri-yah / GYAA-nam LAB-dhvaa pa-RAAM SHAAN-tim a-chi-RAY-naa-dhi-GACH-cha-ti
translation: The person of faith, devoted to it, with senses restrained, gains knowledge; having gained knowledge, one soon reaches the highest peace.
source: Bhagavad Gita 4.39, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%9C%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%9E%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%A8%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Which of the three — trust, commitment, or restraint — is the weakest link in your practice right now?

translations.hi: श्रद्धावान, उसमें लगा हुआ, संयत इन्द्रियों वाला व्यक्ति ज्ञान पाता है; और ज्ञान पाकर वह शीघ्र ही परम शांति तक पहुँच जाता है।

devanagari: तस्मादज्ञानसम्भूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनात्मनः । / छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत ॥4.42॥
iast: tasmādajñānasambhūtaṃ hṛtsthaṃ jñānāsinātmanaḥ । / chittvainaṃ saṃśayaṃ yogamātiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhārata ॥4.42॥
sayIt: tas-MAAD ag-yaa-na-sam-BHOO-tam HRIT-stham gyaa-NAA-si-NAAT-ma-nah / chit-TVAI-nam san-SHA-yam YO-gam aa-TISH-thot-TISH-tha BHAA-ra-ta
translation: Therefore, with the sword of knowledge cut this doubt of yours, born of ignorance and seated in the heart; take your stand in yoga and arise, O Bharata.
source: Bhagavad Gita 4.42, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%9C%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%9E%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%A8%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What decision have you already examined enough — and what would standing up on it look like today?

translations.hi: इसलिए अज्ञान से उपजे, हृदय में बैठे अपने इस संशय को ज्ञान की तलवार से काट डालो; योग में खड़े हो जाओ और हे भारत, उठो।

devanagari: ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति । / निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते ॥5.3॥
iast: jñeyaḥ sa nityasaṃnyāsī yo na dveṣṭi na kāṅkṣati । / nirdvandvo hi mahābāho sukhaṃ bandhātpramucyate ॥5.3॥
sayIt: GYAY-yah sa nit-ya-sun-NYAA-see yo na DVESH-ti na KAANK-sha-ti / nir-DVUN-dvo hi ma-haa-BAA-ho SU-khum bun-DHAAT pra-MOOCH-ya-tay
translation: Know that person as a perpetual renunciant who neither hates nor craves; free from the pairs of opposites, O mighty-armed one, they are easily released from bondage.
source: Bhagavad Gita 5.3, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Where in today's plans are you quietly hating one outcome and craving another — and what would it feel like to hold both loosely?

translations.hi: उसे नित्य संन्यासी जानो जो न द्वेष करता है, न कामना; हे महाबाहु, द्वंद्वों से मुक्त वह व्यक्ति सहज ही बंधन से छूट जाता है।

devanagari: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः । / लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ॥5.10॥
iast: brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ । / lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāmbhasā ॥5.10॥
sayIt: brah-mun-YAA-dhaa-ya kar-MAA-ni SUN-gum tyukt-VAA ka-RO-ti yah / LIP-ya-tay na sa paa-PAY-na pud-ma-PUT-rum i-VAAM-bha-saa
translation: One who acts with attachment abandoned, placing all actions in Brahman, is untouched by sin, as a lotus leaf is untouched by water.
source: Bhagavad Gita 5.10, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What is one task you could do today as an offering, letting both the credit and the blame roll off like water from a lotus leaf?

translations.hi: जो आसक्ति त्यागकर, सारे कर्म ब्रह्म में अर्पित करके कर्म करता है, उसे पाप वैसे ही नहीं छूता जैसे कमल के पत्ते को पानी।

devanagari: ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः । / तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम् ॥5.16॥
iast: jñānena tu tadajñānaṃ yeṣāṃ nāśitamātmanaḥ । / teṣāmādityavajjñānaṃ prakāśayati tatparam ॥5.16॥
sayIt: gyaa-NAY-na tu tud ug-YAA-num YAY-shaam NAA-shi-tum AAT-ma-nah / TAY-shaam aa-DIT-ya-vuj GYAA-num pra-KAA-sha-ya-ti tut PA-rum
translation: But for those in whom that ignorance of the self is destroyed by knowledge, their knowledge, like the sun, lights up the Supreme.
source: Bhagavad Gita 5.16, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What is one assumption about yourself you could bring into the light today instead of leaving it in the dark?

translations.hi: पर जिनके भीतर आत्मा का वह अज्ञान ज्ञान से नष्ट हो चुका है, उनका ज्ञान सूर्य की तरह उस परम तत्त्व को प्रकाशित कर देता है।

devanagari: विद्याविनयसंपन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि । / शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः ॥5.18॥
iast: vidyāvinayasaṃpanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini । / śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ ॥5.18॥
sayIt: vid-YAA-vi-na-ya-sum-PUN-nay BRAAH-ma-nay GU-vi HUS-ti-ni / SHU-ni CHAI-va shva-PAA-kay cha PUN-di-taah sa-ma-DAR-shi-nah
translation: The wise look with an equal eye upon a brahmin endowed with learning and humility, a cow, an elephant, a dog, and an outcaste.
source: Bhagavad Gita 5.18, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Who did you look past or quietly rank beneath you today, and what changes if you look again with an equal eye?

translations.hi: विद्या और विनय से संपन्न ब्राह्मण, गाय, हाथी, कुत्ते और चांडाल — इन सब पर ज्ञानी समान दृष्टि से देखते हैं।

devanagari: न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम् । / स्थिरबुद्धिरसंमूढो ब्रह्मविद्ब्रह्मणि स्थितः ॥5.20॥
iast: na prahṛṣyetpriyaṃ prāpya nodvijetprāpya cāpriyam । / sthirabuddhirasaṃmūḍho brahmavidbrahmaṇi sthitaḥ ॥5.20॥
sayIt: na pra-HRISH-yet PRI-yum PRAAP-ya nod-VI-jet PRAAP-ya CHAAP-ri-yum / sthi-ra-BUD-dhir a-sum-MOO-dho BRAH-ma-vid BRAH-ma-ni STHI-tah
translation: One should not exult on gaining the pleasant, nor be shaken on meeting the unpleasant; with steady understanding and free of delusion, the knower of Brahman stands established in Brahman.
source: Bhagavad Gita 5.20, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What news — good or bad — are you bracing for right now, and could you meet either kind without losing your footing?

translations.hi: प्रिय को पाकर न फूल उठे, न अप्रिय को पाकर विचलित हो; स्थिर बुद्धि वाला, मोह से मुक्त ब्रह्मवेत्ता ब्रह्म में स्थित रहता है।

devanagari: ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते । / आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः ॥5.22॥
iast: ye hi saṃsparśajā bhogā duḥkhayonaya eva te । / ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣu ramate budhaḥ ॥5.22॥
sayIt: yay hi sum-spar-sha-JAA BHO-gaa DUH-kha-YO-na-ya AY-va tay / aad-YUN-ta-vun-tah kown-TAY-ya na TAY-shoo RA-ma-tay BU-dhah
translation: The enjoyments born of contact with the senses are truly wombs of sorrow; they have a beginning and an end, O son of Kunti — the wise take no delight in them.
source: Bhagavad Gita 5.22, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Which pleasure do you keep returning to even though you already know exactly how it ends?

translations.hi: इन्द्रिय-संपर्क से उपजे भोग वास्तव में दुःख की जननी हैं; उनका आदि है और अन्त भी, हे कुन्तीपुत्र — ज्ञानी उनमें रमता नहीं।

devanagari: शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात् । / कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः ॥5.23॥
iast: śaknotīhaiva yaḥ soḍhuṃ prākśarīravimokṣaṇāt । / kāmakrodhodbhavaṃ vegaṃ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ ॥5.23॥
sayIt: shak-NO-tee-HAI-va yah SO-dhum praak sha-REE-ra-vi-MOK-sha-naat / kaa-ma-kro-DHOD-bha-vum VAY-gum sa YUK-tah sa su-KHEE na-rah
translation: One who can withstand, right here before leaving the body, the surge born of desire and anger — that person is a yogi, and that person is happy.
source: Bhagavad Gita 5.23, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: When desire or anger last surged in you, what happened in the space between feeling it and acting on it?

translations.hi: जो इसी जीवन में, शरीर छोड़ने से पहले, काम और क्रोध से उठे वेग को झेल सकता है — वही योगी है, और वही सुखी मनुष्य है।

devanagari: योऽन्तःसुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिरेव यः । / स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति ॥5.24॥
iast: yo'ntaḥsukho'ntarārāmastathāntarjyotireva yaḥ । / sa yogī brahmanirvāṇaṃ brahmabhūto'dhigacchati ॥5.24॥
sayIt: yon-tah-SU-kho un-ta-RAA-raa-mus ta-THAAN-tar-JYO-tir AY-va yah / sa YO-gee brah-ma-nir-VAA-num brah-ma-BHOO-to dhi-GUCH-chha-ti
translation: The one whose happiness is within, whose delight is within, and whose light is within — that yogi, having become one with Brahman, attains the stillness of Brahman.
source: Bhagavad Gita 5.24, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What would today look like if you drew your contentment from within instead of waiting for it to be delivered?

translations.hi: जिसका सुख भीतर है, जिसका आनन्द भीतर है, और जिसकी ज्योति भीतर है — वह योगी ब्रह्म-रूप होकर ब्रह्म की शान्ति को पाता है।

devanagari: लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः । / छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥5.25॥
iast: labhante brahmanirvāṇamṛṣayaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ । / chinnadvaidhā yatātmānaḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ॥5.25॥
sayIt: la-BHUN-tay brah-ma-nir-VAA-num RI-sha-yah KSHEE-na-KUL-ma-shaah / chhin-na-DVAI-dhaa ya-TAAT-maa-nah sar-va-BHOO-ta-hi-tay ra-TAAH
translation: The seers whose faults are worn away and whose doubts are cut, who are self-restrained and delight in the welfare of all beings, attain the stillness of Brahman.
source: Bhagavad Gita 5.25, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Whose welfare, beyond your own circle, could your effort quietly serve today?

translations.hi: जिन ऋषियों के दोष क्षीण हो चुके हैं और संशय कट चुके हैं, जो संयमी हैं और सब प्राणियों के हित में रमते हैं, वे ब्रह्म की शान्ति को पाते हैं।

devanagari: भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् । / सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति ॥5.29॥
iast: bhoktāraṃ yajñatapasāṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram । / suhṛdaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jñātvā māṃ śāntimṛcchati ॥5.29॥
sayIt: bhok-TAA-rum yug-nya-ta-pa-SAAM sar-va-LO-ka-ma-HAYSH-va-rum / su-HRI-dum sar-va-bhoo-TAA-naam GYAAT-vaa maam SHAAN-tim RICH-chha-ti
translation: Knowing Me as the enjoyer of all sacrifices and austerities, the great Lord of all the worlds, and the friend of every being, one reaches peace.
source: Bhagavad Gita 5.29, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What burden becomes lighter if the results of your efforts already belong to a friend who wills your good?

translations.hi: मुझे सब यज्ञों और तपों का भोक्ता, सब लोकों का महान ईश्वर, और हर प्राणी का मित्र जानकर मनुष्य शान्ति पा लेता है।

devanagari: उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् । / आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ॥6.5॥
iast: uddharedātmanātmānaṃ nātmānamavasādayet । / ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ ॥6.5॥
sayIt: ood-dha-ray-DAAT-ma-NAAT-maa-num NAAT-maa-na-ma-va-SAA-da-yet / aat-MY-va HYAAT-ma-no BUN-dhoo-raat-MY-va ri-poo-RAAT-ma-naha
translation: Let a person lift himself up by his own self; let him not drag himself down. For the self alone is the friend of the self, and the self alone is the enemy of the self.
source: Bhagavad Gita 6.5, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%86%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Where today did you talk yourself down when you could have lifted yourself up?

translations.hi: मनुष्य अपने ही सहारे अपना उत्थान करे; स्वयं को नीचे न गिराए। क्योंकि आत्मा ही आत्मा का मित्र है, और आत्मा ही आत्मा का शत्रु।

devanagari: बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः । / अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत् ॥6.6॥
iast: bandhurātmātmanastasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ । / anātmanastu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatruvat ॥6.6॥
sayIt: BUN-dhoo-RAAT-MAAT-ma-nus-TUS-ya yay-NAAT-my-VAAT-ma-naa ji-taha / a-NAAT-ma-nus-too SHUT-root-vay var-tay-TAAT-my-va SHUT-roo-vut
translation: For one who has conquered the self by the self, the self is a friend; but for one who has not mastered the self, the self itself acts in hostility, like an enemy.
source: Bhagavad Gita 6.6, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%86%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: In which habit is your own mind currently acting more like an enemy than a friend?

translations.hi: जिसने स्वयं के द्वारा स्वयं को जीत लिया है, उसके लिए आत्मा मित्र है; पर जिसने स्वयं को वश में नहीं किया, उसके लिए वही आत्मा शत्रु की तरह शत्रुता में बरतती है।

devanagari: नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः । / न चाति स्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन ॥6.16॥
iast: nātyaśnatastu yogo'sti na caikāntamanaśnataḥ । / na cāti svapnaśīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna ॥6.16॥
sayIt: NAAT-yush-na-tus-too YO-go-sti na chai-KAAN-ta-ma-NUSH-na-taha / na CHAA-ti svup-na-SHEE-lus-ya JAA-gra-to NY-va CHAAR-joo-na
translation: Yoga is not for one who eats too much, nor for one who does not eat at all; not for one given to too much sleep, nor for one who stays always awake, Arjuna.
source: Bhagavad Gita 6.16, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%86%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Which extreme — too much or too little — is quietly unbalancing your practice right now?

translations.hi: योग न उसके लिए है जो बहुत खाता है, न उसके लिए जो बिल्कुल नहीं खाता; न उसके लिए जो बहुत सोता है, न उसके लिए जो हमेशा जागता रहता है, अर्जुन।

devanagari: युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु । / युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ॥6.17॥
iast: yuktāhāravihārasya yuktaceṣṭasya karmasu । / yuktasvapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkhahā ॥6.17॥
sayIt: yook-TAA-haa-ra-vi-HAA-rus-ya yook-ta-CHESH-tus-ya KAR-ma-soo / yook-ta-svup-NAA-va-BO-dhus-ya YO-go BHA-va-ti dooh-kha-HAA
translation: For one measured in food and recreation, measured in effort in all actions, measured in sleep and waking, yoga becomes the destroyer of sorrow.
source: Bhagavad Gita 6.17, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%86%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Where could one measured adjustment — in food, rest, or work — reduce your daily friction?

translations.hi: जिसका आहार और विहार नपा-तुला है, कर्मों में जिसकी चेष्टा नपी-तुली है, जिसका सोना और जागना नपा-तुला है — उसके लिए योग दुःख का नाश करने वाला बन जाता है।

devanagari: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता । / योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः ॥6.19॥
iast: yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā । / yogino yatacittasya yuñjato yogamātmanaḥ ॥6.19॥
sayIt: ya-THAA DEE-po ni-VAA-tus-tho NENG-ga-tay so-pa-MAA smri-TAA / YO-gi-no ya-ta-CHIT-tus-ya YOON-ja-to yo-ga-MAAT-ma-naha
translation: As a lamp standing in a windless place does not flicker — that is the simile recalled for the yogi of restrained mind, practising the yoga of the self.
source: Bhagavad Gita 6.19, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%86%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What would a windless place look like in your day — and when could you sit in it?

translations.hi: जैसे बिना हवा की जगह रखा दीपक काँपता नहीं — वही उपमा उस संयत-चित्त योगी के लिए कही गई है, जो आत्मा के योग का अभ्यास करता है।

devanagari: यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् । / ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत् ॥6.26॥
iast: yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram । / tatastato niyamyaitadātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet ॥6.26॥
sayIt: ya-TO ya-TO nish-CHA-ra-ti ma-nush-CHUN-cha-la-mus-THI-rum / ta-tus-ta-TO ni-yum-YAI-ta-DAAT-mun-YAY-va VA-shum na-yet
translation: Wherever the restless, unsteady mind wanders off, from precisely there let one rein it in and bring it back under the control of the self alone.
source: Bhagavad Gita 6.26, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%86%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: The next time your mind wanders today, can you bring it back once, without scolding it?

translations.hi: यह चंचल, अस्थिर मन जहाँ-जहाँ भटक जाए, वहीं-वहीं से उसे रोककर आत्मा के ही वश में वापस ले आए।

devanagari: सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि । / ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः ॥6.29॥
iast: sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani । / īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ ॥6.29॥
sayIt: sar-va-BHOO-tus-tha-MAAT-maa-num sar-va-BHOO-taa-ni CHAAT-ma-ni / EEK-sha-tay yo-ga-yook-TAAT-maa SAR-va-tra sa-ma-DAR-sha-naha
translation: One whose self is joined in yoga, seeing the same everywhere, sees the self present in all beings and all beings in the self.
source: Bhagavad Gita 6.29, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%86%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Who did you meet today in whom you did not look for the same self that is in you?

translations.hi: जिसकी आत्मा योग में जुड़ी है और जो सर्वत्र समान देखता है, वह आत्मा को सब प्राणियों में और सब प्राणियों को आत्मा में देखता है।

devanagari: यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति । / तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ॥6.30॥
iast: yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati । / tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati ॥6.30॥
sayIt: yo MAAM PUSH-ya-ti SAR-va-tra SAR-vum cha MA-yi PUSH-ya-ti / tus-YAA-hum na pra-nush-YAA-mi sa cha may na pra-NUSH-ya-ti
translation: Whoever sees me everywhere and sees everything in me — to him I am never lost, and he is never lost to me.
source: Bhagavad Gita 6.30, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%86%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What ordinary thing could you look at today as held within the divine?

translations.hi: जो मुझे हर जगह देखता है और सब कुछ मुझमें देखता है — उसके लिए मैं कभी ओझल नहीं होता, और वह मुझसे कभी ओझल नहीं होता।

devanagari: आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन । / सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः ॥6.32॥
iast: ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo'rjuna । / sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ ॥6.32॥
sayIt: aat-MOW-pum-YAY-na SAR-va-tra SA-mum PUSH-ya-ti YOR-joo-na / SOO-khum vaa YA-di vaa DOOH-khum sa YO-gee PA-ra-mo ma-taha
translation: One who sees the same everywhere by comparison with himself, Arjuna — whether in joy or in sorrow — that yogi is held to be the highest.
source: Bhagavad Gita 6.32, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%86%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Whose joy or pain today can you measure by asking how it would feel as your own?

translations.hi: जो अपने से तुलना करके सबको हर जगह समान देखता है, अर्जुन — चाहे सुख हो या दुःख — वह योगी सर्वोच्च माना गया है।

devanagari: श्रीभगवानुवाच / असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् । / अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ॥6.35॥
iast: śrībhagavānuvāca / asaṃśayaṃ mahābāho mano durnigrahaṃ calam । / abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate ॥6.35॥
sayIt: shree-bha-ga-VAA-noo-VAA-cha / a-SUM-sha-yum ma-HAA-BAA-ho MA-no door-NI-gra-hum cha-lum / abh-YAA-say-na too kown-TAY-ya vy-RAAG-yay-na cha GRIH-ya-tay
translation: The Blessed Lord said: Without doubt, mighty-armed one, the mind is restless and hard to restrain; but by practice, son of Kunti, and by dispassion, it is grasped.
source: Bhagavad Gita 6.35, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%86%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What small practice could you repeat tomorrow, even though your mind resisted it today?

translations.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: इसमें संदेह नहीं, हे महाबाहु, मन चंचल है और कठिनाई से वश में आता है; पर अभ्यास से, हे कुन्तीपुत्र, और वैराग्य से वह पकड़ में आ जाता है।

devanagari: अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते । / तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥9.22॥
iast: ananyāścintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate । / teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham ॥9.22॥
sayIt: a-nun-YAASH chin-ta-YUN-toh maam yay ja-NAAH par-yoo-PAA-sa-tay / tay-SHAAM nit-YAA-bhi-yook-TAA-naam yo-ga-KSHAY-mum va-HAAM-ya-hum
translation: Those who worship me with undivided attention, thinking of nothing else — for those ever-steadfast people I carry what they lack and preserve what they have.
source: Bhagavad Gita 9.22, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%9C%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%9C%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%81%E0%A4%B9%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Which worry about getting or keeping could you set down today, and hand over?

translations.hi: जो अनन्य भाव से, और कुछ न सोचते हुए, मेरी उपासना करते हैं — उन नित्य जुड़े हुए लोगों के लिए, जो नहीं है वह लाने और जो है उसे सहेजने का भार मैं स्वयं उठाता हूँ।

devanagari: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति । / तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥9.26॥
iast: patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati । / tadahaṃ bhaktyupahṛtamaśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ ॥9.26॥
sayIt: PUT-rum POOSH-pum PHA-lum TOH-yum yoh may BHAK-tyaa pra-YUCH-cha-ti / ta-DA-hum bhak-tyoo-pa-HRI-tum ush-NAA-mi pra-ya-TAAT-ma-nah
translation: Whoever offers me a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water with devotion — that offering of love from a person of pure heart, I accept.
source: Bhagavad Gita 9.26, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%9C%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%9C%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%81%E0%A4%B9%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: What small, ordinary thing could you offer today with your whole attention?

translations.hi: जो कोई मुझे पत्ता, फूल, फल या जल भक्ति से अर्पित करता है — शुद्ध हृदय वाले का वह प्रेम से लाया अर्पण मैं स्वीकार करता हूँ।

devanagari: यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत् । / यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम् ॥9.27॥
iast: yatkaroṣi yadaśnāsi yajjuhoṣi dadāsi yat । / yattapasyasi kaunteya tatkuruṣva madarpaṇam ॥9.27॥
sayIt: yut ka-ROH-shi ya-dush-NAA-si yuj joo-HOH-shi da-DAA-si yut / yut ta-PUS-ya-si kown-TAY-ya tut koo-ROOSH-va ma-DAR-pa-num
translation: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give, whatever austerity you practise, O son of Kunti — do it as an offering to me.
source: Bhagavad Gita 9.27, Sanskrit Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA, https://sa.wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE/%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%9C%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%9C%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%81%E0%A4%B9%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%97%E0%A4%83; translation: Sandhya draft, pending review
reflection: Which routine act today will you quietly turn into an offering?
