iast: nakhairnākastrīṇāṃ karakamalasaṃkocaśaśibhi / starūṇāṃ divyānāṃ hasata iva te caṇḍi caraṇau । / phalāni svaḥsthebhyaḥ kisalayakarāgreṇa dadatāṃ / daridrebhyo bhadrāṃ śriyamaniśamahnāya dadatau ॥89॥
sayIt: na-khair-naa-kas-tree-NAAM ka-ra-ka-ma-la-sun-KO-cha-sha-shi-bhih / sta-roo-NAAM div-YAA-naam HA-sa-ta i-va tay CHUN-di cha-ra-nau / pha-LAA-ni svah-STHAYB-hyah ki-sa-la-ya-ka-RAAG-ray-na da-da-taam / da-rid-RAYB-hyo bhad-RAAM shri-ya-ma-ni-sha-mah-NAA-ya da-da-tau
translation: O Chandi, your feet — their nails moons at whose rising the lotus-hands of heaven's women fold shut — seem to laugh at the divine wish-granting trees: those trees hand their fruit to heaven's residents with sprout-soft fingertips, while your feet give safe and auspicious fortune to the poor, unceasingly, and at once.
source: Soundarya Lahari 89 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: Does your generosity mostly reach the people who could repay you, or the people who never could?

translations.hi: हे चण्डी, तुम्हारे चरण — जिनके नख वे चन्द्रमा हैं जिनके उदय पर स्वर्ग-सुन्दरियों के कर-कमल (प्रणाम में) मुँद जाते हैं — मानो दिव्य कल्पवृक्षों पर हँसते हैं: वे वृक्ष स्वर्गवासियों को ही कोंपल-से कोमल हाथों की उँगलियों से फल थमाते हैं, जबकि तुम्हारे चरण दरिद्रों को कल्याणकारी लक्ष्मी देते हैं — निरन्तर, और तत्काल।

devanagari: ददाने दीनेभ्यः श्रियमनिशमाशानुसदृशी / ममन्दं सौन्दर्यप्रकरमकरन्दम् विकिरति । / तवास्मिन् मन्दारस्तबकसुभगे यातु चरणे / निमज्जन्मज्जीवः करणचरणः षट्चरणताम् ॥90॥
iast: dadāne dīnebhyaḥ śriyamaniśamāśānusadṛśī / mamandaṃ saundaryaprakaramakarandam vikirati । / tavāsmin mandārastabakasubhage yātu caraṇe / nimajjanmajjīvaḥ karaṇacaraṇaḥ ṣaṭcaraṇatām ॥90॥
sayIt: da-DAA-nay dee-NAYB-hyah shri-ya-ma-ni-sha-MAA-shaa-noo-sad-ri-sheem / a-MUN-dum saun-DUR-ya-pra-ka-ra-ma-ka-RUN-dum vi-ki-ra-ti / ta-VAAS-min mun-DAA-ra-sta-ba-ka-soo-bha-GAY YAA-too cha-ra-nay / ni-muj-jun-muj-JEE-vah ka-ra-na-cha-ra-nah shat-cha-ra-na-TAAM
translation: Into this foot of yours — lovely as a spray of mandara blossoms, endlessly granting the destitute wealth to match their hope, scattering unstintingly the honey of its massed beauty — may my life plunge, and, making the senses its feet, become the six-footed bee.
source: Soundarya Lahari 90 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: If all five of your senses and your mind had to settle on a single flower today, what would deserve them?

translations.hi: तुम्हारे इस चरण में — जो मन्दार के गुच्छे-सा सुहावना है, दीनों को उनकी आशा के अनुरूप सम्पदा अनवरत देता है, और अपने सौन्दर्य-राशि का मकरन्द जी खोलकर बिखेरता है — मेरा जीवन डूब जाए, और इन्द्रियों को अपने पाँव बनाकर छह पाँवों वाला भ्रमर बन जाए।

devanagari: पदन्यासक्रीडापरिचयमिवारब्धुमनसः / स्खलन्तस्ते खेलं भवनकलहंसा न जहति । / अतस्तेषां शिक्षां सुभगमणिमञ्जीररणित / च्छलादाचक्षाणं चरणकमलं चारुचरिते ॥91॥
iast: padanyāsakrīḍāparicayamivārabdhumanasaḥ / skhalantaste khelaṃ bhavanakalahaṃsā na jahati । / atasteṣāṃ śikṣāṃ subhagamaṇimañjīraraṇita / cchalādācakṣāṇaṃ caraṇakamalaṃ cārucarite ॥91॥
sayIt: pa-dun-yaa-sa-kree-DAA-pa-ri-cha-ya-mi-VAA-rub-dhoo-ma-na-sah / skha-LUN-tas-tay KHAY-lum bha-va-na-ka-la-HUN-saa na JA-ha-ti / a-tas-TAY-shaam SHIK-shaam soo-bha-ga-ma-ni-mun-JEE-ra-ra-ni-ta / chha-LAA-daa-chak-SHAA-num cha-ra-na-ka-ma-LUM chaa-roo-cha-ri-tay
translation: O lady of lovely ways, the royal swans of your household, as if set on learning the art of your playful gait, keep stumbling after it — and still will not give up the game; and so your lotus foot, under cover of the ringing of its lovely jewelled anklets, seems to be calling out their lesson.
source: Soundarya Lahari 91 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: Who is quietly learning from the way you move through an ordinary day, whether or not you mean to be teaching?

translations.hi: हे चारुचरिते, तुम्हारे भवन के राजहंस मानो तुम्हारी चाल की क्रीड़ा सीखने की ठान कर उसके पीछे लड़खड़ाते चलते हैं — फिर भी वह खेल छोड़ते नहीं; इसीलिए तुम्हारा चरण-कमल अपने सुन्दर मणि-नूपुरों की रुनझुन के बहाने मानो उन्हें बोल-बोलकर पाठ सिखा रहा है।

devanagari: गतास्ते मञ्चत्वं द्रुहिणहरिरुद्रेश्वरभृतः / शिवः स्वच्छच्छायाघटितकपटप्रच्छदपटः । / त्वदीयानां भासां प्रतिफलनरागारुणतया / शरीरी शृङ्गारो रस इव दृशां दोग्धि कुतुकम् ॥92॥
iast: gatāste mañcatvaṃ druhiṇaharirudreśvarabhṛtaḥ / śivaḥ svacchacchāyāghaṭitakapaṭapracchadapaṭaḥ । / tvadīyānāṃ bhāsāṃ pratiphalanarāgāruṇatayā / śarīrī śṛṅgāro rasa iva dṛśāṃ dogdhi kutukam ॥92॥
sayIt: ga-TAAS-tay mun-CHUT-vum droo-hi-na-ha-ri-rood-RESH-va-ra-bhri-tah / shi-VUH svach-chhach-chhaa-yaa-gha-ti-ta-ka-pa-ta-prach-chha-da-pa-tah / tva-dee-YAA-naam bhaa-SAAM pra-ti-pha-la-na-raa-GAA-roo-na-ta-yaa / sha-REE-ree shrin-GAA-ro RA-sa i-va dri-SHAAM DOG-dhi koo-too-kum
translation: Druhina, Hari, Rudra and Ishvara, bearing you up, have become your couch; Shiva is its coverlet, feigned out of his own clear white radiance — and, flushed red by the reflection of your glow, he yields wonder to the eyes, as though love's own rasa had taken a body.
source: Soundarya Lahari 92 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: If the powers you most respect turned out to be furniture in the presence of something greater, how would your fears rearrange themselves?

translations.hi: द्रुहिण (ब्रह्मा), हरि, रुद्र और ईश्वर — तुम्हें धारण किए हुए — तुम्हारे पर्यंक (के पाये) बन गए हैं; और शिव (सदाशिव) अपनी निर्मल श्वेत आभा से रचा हुआ मानो उसका छद्म-आच्छादन हैं — जो तुम्हारी कान्ति के प्रतिबिम्ब से अरुण होकर आँखों में विस्मय भर देते हैं, मानो शृंगार-रस ने ही देह धारण कर ली हो।

devanagari: अराला केशेषु प्रकृतिसरला मन्दहसिते / शिरीषाभा चित्ते दृषदुपलशोभा कुचतटे । / भृशं तन्वी मध्ये पृथुरुरसिजारोहविषये / जगत्त्रातुं शम्भोर्जयति करुणा काचिदरुणा ॥93॥
iast: arālā keśeṣu prakṛtisaralā mandahasite / śirīṣābhā citte dṛṣadupalaśobhā kucataṭe । / bhṛśaṃ tanvī madhye pṛthururasijārohaviṣaye / jagattrātuṃ śambhorjayati karuṇā kācidaruṇā ॥93॥
sayIt: a-raa-LAA kay-SHAY-shoo pra-kri-ti-sa-ra-LAA mun-da-ha-si-TAY / shi-ree-SHAA-bhaa chit-TAY dri-sha-doo-pa-la-SHO-bhaa koo-cha-ta-tay / bhri-SHUM tun-VEE MAD-hyay pri-thoo-roo-ra-si-jaa-RO-ha-vi-sha-yay / ja-gat-TRAA-toom shum-BHOR-ja-ya-ti ka-roo-NAA KAA-chi-da-roo-naa
translation: Curved only in her hair, by nature straight in her gentle smile; soft as shirisha blossom in her heart, firm as grinding-stone only at her breasts; utterly slender at the waist, generous in bosom and hip — so, to save the world, a certain rosy compassion of Shambhu stands victorious.
source: Soundarya Lahari 93 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: Where could you relocate your hardness so that, like this verse's, it never lands on anyone's heart?

translations.hi: केशों में ही टेढ़ी, स्वभाव से मन्द मुस्कान में सीधी-सरल; चित्त में शिरीष के फूल-सी कोमल, केवल कुच-तट पर सिल-पत्थर-सी कठोर; कमर में अत्यन्त क्षीण, और उरोज तथा नितम्ब के प्रदेश में भरी-पूरी — इस तरह जगत की रक्षा के लिए शम्भु की कोई अरुण (गुलाबी) करुणा ही विजयिनी होकर विराजती है।

devanagari: कलङ्कः कस्तूरी रजनिकरबिम्बं जलमयं / कलाभिः कर्पूरैर्मरकतकरण्डं निबिडितम् । / अतस्त्वद्भोगेन प्रतिदिनमिदं रिक्तकुहरं / विधिर्भूयो भूयो निबिडयति नूनं तव कृते ॥94॥
iast: kalaṅkaḥ kastūrī rajanikarabimbaṃ jalamayaṃ / kalābhiḥ karpūrairmarakatakaraṇḍaṃ nibiḍitam । / atastvadbhogena pratidinamidaṃ riktakuharaṃ / vidhirbhūyo bhūyo nibiḍayati nūnaṃ tava kṛte ॥94॥
sayIt: ka-LUN-kah kas-TOO-ree ra-ja-ni-ka-ra-BIM-bum ja-la-ma-yum / ka-LAA-bhih kar-POO-rair-ma-ra-ka-ta-ka-RUN-dum ni-bi-di-tum / a-tas-tvad-BHO-gay-na pra-ti-di-na-mi-DUM rik-ta-koo-ha-rum / vi-dhir-BHOO-yo BHOO-yo ni-bi-da-ya-ti NOO-num TA-va kri-tay
translation: The moon's dark mark is musk; the watery orb of the night-maker is an emerald casket packed tight with camphor-flakes — its own digits. And so, its hollow emptied day by day through your use of it, the Creator surely packs it full again and again, for your sake.
source: Soundarya Lahari 94 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: Which recurring cycle in your life could you re-see as replenishment arriving, rather than as something being taken away?

translations.hi: चन्द्रमा का कलंक कस्तूरी है; जल-मय चन्द्र-बिम्ब एक मरकत (पन्ने) की पिटारी है, जो कलाओं-रूपी कपूर से ठसाठस भरी है। इसीलिए तुम्हारे प्रतिदिन के उपयोग से जब उसका भीतर खाली हो जाता है, तो विधाता निश्चय ही तुम्हारे लिए उसे बार-बार फिर से भर देता है।

devanagari: पुरारातेरन्तःपुरमसि ततस्त्वच्चरणयोः / सपर्यामर्यादा तरलकरणानामसुलभा । / तथा ह्येते नीताः शतमखमुखाः सिद्धिमतुलां / तव द्वारोपान्तस्थितिभिरणिमाद्याभिरमराः ॥95॥
iast: purārāterantaḥpuramasi tatastvaccaraṇayoḥ / saparyāmaryādā taralakaraṇānāmasulabhā । / tathā hyete nītāḥ śatamakhamukhāḥ siddhimatulāṃ / tava dvāropāntasthitibhiraṇimādyābhiramarāḥ ॥95॥
sayIt: poo-raa-RAA-tay-ran-tah-poo-ra-ma-si ta-tas-tvach-cha-ra-na-YOH / sa-par-YAA-mar-YAA-daa ta-ra-la-ka-ra-NAA-naa-ma-soo-la-bhaa / ta-THAA HYAY-tay NEE-taah sha-ta-ma-kha-moo-KHAAH sid-dhi-ma-too-LAAM / TA-va dvaa-ro-PAAN-ta-sthi-ti-bhi-ra-ni-MAAD-yaa-bhi-ra-ma-raah
translation: You are the inmost queen of the Foe of the Cities; the privilege of waiting closely upon your feet is therefore beyond the reach of those whose senses are restless. So it is that the immortals, Indra at their head, are led to matchless attainment merely by anima and her sister powers — the attendants who stand about your doorway.
source: Soundarya Lahari 95 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: What would it take for your senses to grow quiet enough to be welcomed past the doorway of what you most revere?

translations.hi: तुम त्रिपुर के शत्रु शिव का अन्तःपुर हो — उनकी पटरानी; इसलिए तुम्हारे चरणों की अन्तरंग सेवा का अधिकार चंचल इन्द्रियों वालों को सुलभ नहीं। तभी तो इन्द्र आदि देवता तुम्हारे द्वार के पास खड़ी अणिमा आदि सिद्धियों से ही अतुलनीय उपलब्धि तक पहुँचा दिए गए — भीतर प्रवेश पाए बिना।

devanagari: कलत्रं वैधात्रं कतिकति भजन्ते न कवयः / श्रियो देव्याः को वा न भवति पतिः कैरपि धनैः । / महादेवं हित्वा तव सति सतीनामचरमे / कुचाभ्यामासङ्गः कुरवकतरोरप्यसुलभः ॥96॥
iast: kalatraṃ vaidhātraṃ katikati bhajante na kavayaḥ / śriyo devyāḥ ko vā na bhavati patiḥ kairapi dhanaiḥ । / mahādevaṃ hitvā tava sati satīnāmacarame / kucābhyāmāsaṅgaḥ kuravakatarorapyasulabhaḥ ॥96॥
sayIt: ka-LUT-rum vai-DHAAT-rum ka-ti-ka-ti bha-JUN-tay na ka-va-yah / shri-YO dev-YAAH KO vaa na BHA-va-ti pa-tih kai-ra-pi dha-naih / ma-haa-DAY-vum HIT-vaa TA-va SA-ti sa-tee-NAA-ma-cha-ra-may / koo-CHAAB-hyaa-MAA-sun-gah koo-ra-va-ka-ta-ro-rap-ya-soo-la-bhah
translation: How many poets have not wooed the Creator's consort, speech herself? And who, with wealth of any kind, does not become a lord of the goddess Shri? But you, O virtuous one, first among the faithful — apart from Mahadeva, the embrace of your breasts is beyond reach even of the kuravaka tree in your courtyard.
source: Soundarya Lahari 96 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: What in your life belongs so wholly to one commitment that no amount of talent, wealth, or flattery could borrow it away?

translations.hi: विधाता की पत्नी — स्वयं वाणी — को कितने-कितने कवि नहीं भजते? और किन्हीं भी धनों से कौन श्री-देवी (लक्ष्मी) का पति नहीं बन जाता? पर हे सती, पतिव्रताओं में अग्रगण्या, महादेव को छोड़कर तुम्हारे कुचों का आलिंगन तो आँगन के कुरवक वृक्ष तक को सुलभ नहीं।

devanagari: गिरामाहुर्देवीं द्रुहिणगृहिणीमागमविदो / हरेः पत्नीं पद्मां हरसहचरीमद्रितनयाम् । / तुरीया कापि त्वं दुरधिगमनिःसीममहिमा / महामाया विश्वं भ्रमयसि परब्रह्ममहिषि ॥97॥
iast: girāmāhurdevīṃ druhiṇagṛhiṇīmāgamavido / hareḥ patnīṃ padmāṃ harasahacarīmadritanayām । / turīyā kāpi tvaṃ duradhigamaniḥsīmamahimā / mahāmāyā viśvaṃ bhramayasi parabrahmamahiṣi ॥97॥
sayIt: gi-raa-MAA-hoor-DAY-veem droo-hi-na-gri-hi-NEE-maa-ga-ma-vi-do / ha-RAYH put-NEEM pud-MAAM ha-ra-sa-ha-cha-REE-mad-ri-ta-na-yaam / too-REE-yaa KAA-pi tvum doo-rad-hi-ga-ma-nih-see-ma-ma-hi-maa / ma-haa-MAA-yaa VISH-vum bhra-ma-ya-si pa-ra-brah-ma-ma-hi-shi
translation: The knowers of the scriptures call you the goddess of words, the Creator's wife; or Padma, wife of Hari; or the Mountain's daughter, Hara's companion. But you are some fourth beyond them — your greatness boundless and past reaching — Mahamaya, queen of the supreme Brahman, and you set the whole universe turning.
source: Soundarya Lahari 97 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: When you name what you worship, do the names ever tempt you to forget how much lies beyond them?

translations.hi: आगमों के ज्ञाता तुम्हें वाणी की देवी — विधाता की गृहिणी कहते हैं; या हरि की पत्नी पद्मा; या हर की सहचरी, गिरि-कन्या। पर तुम इन सबसे परे कोई चौथी हो — जिसकी महिमा असीम है और पहुँच से परे — महामाया, परब्रह्म की महिषी, जो इस समूचे विश्व को घुमा रही हो।

devanagari: कदा काले मातः कथय कलितालक्तकरसं / पिबेयं विद्यार्थी तव चरणनिर्णेजनजलम् । / प्रकृत्या मूकानामपि च कविताकारणतया / कदा धत्ते वाणीमुखकमलताम्बूलरसताम् ॥98॥
iast: kadā kāle mātaḥ kathaya kalitālaktakarasaṃ / pibeyaṃ vidyārthī tava caraṇanirṇejanajalam । / prakṛtyā mūkānāmapi ca kavitākāraṇatayā / kadā dhatte vāṇīmukhakamalatāmbūlarasatām ॥98॥
sayIt: ka-DAA KAA-lay MAA-tah KA-tha-ya ka-li-taa-luk-ta-ka-ra-sum / pi-BAY-yum vid-YAAR-thee TA-va cha-ra-na-nir-NAY-ja-na-ja-lum / pra-krit-YAA moo-KAA-naa-ma-pi cha ka-vi-taa-KAA-ra-na-ta-yaa / ka-DAA DHUT-tay vaa-nee-moo-kha-ka-ma-la-taam-BOO-la-ra-sa-taam
translation: Tell me, Mother: when shall I, a student of wisdom, drink the water that has bathed your feet, tinged with the juice of their lac-dye? That water makes poets even of the born-mute — when will it become for me the betel-juice from the lotus mouth of the goddess of speech?
source: Soundarya Lahari 98 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: What are you hoping to receive from grace that you have never yet been willing to ask for out loud?

translations.hi: बताओ माँ, वह घड़ी कब आएगी जब मैं — विद्या का अर्थी — तुम्हारे चरण धोने का वह जल पिऊँगा, जिसमें महावर का रस घुला है? वह जल जन्म के मूक को भी कवि बना देता है — मेरे लिए वह वाणी (सरस्वती) के मुख-कमल का ताम्बूल-रस कब बनेगा?

devanagari: सरस्वत्या लक्ष्म्या विधिहरिसपत्नो विहरते / रतेः पातिव्रत्यं शिथिलयति रम्येण वपुषा । / चिरं जीवन्नेव क्षपितपशुपाशव्यतिकरः / परानन्दाभिख्यम् रसयति रसं त्वद्भजनवान् ॥99॥
iast: sarasvatyā lakṣmyā vidhiharisapatno viharate / rateḥ pātivratyaṃ śithilayati ramyeṇa vapuṣā । / ciraṃ jīvanneva kṣapitapaśupāśavyatikaraḥ / parānandābhikhyam rasayati rasaṃ tvadbhajanavān ॥99॥
sayIt: sa-ras-vat-YAA luk-SHMYAA vi-dhi-ha-ri-sa-put-no vi-ha-ra-tay / ra-TAYH paa-tiv-rut-yum shi-thi-la-ya-ti rum-YAY-na va-poo-shaa / chi-RUM JEE-vun-NAY-va ksha-pi-ta-pa-shoo-paa-sha-vya-ti-ka-rah / pa-raa-nun-DAA-bhikh-yum ra-sa-ya-ti RA-sum tvad-bha-ja-na-vaan
translation: Your worshipper sports with Sarasvati and with Lakshmi, a rival to the Creator and to Hari; with his winning form he loosens even Rati's wifely fidelity. Living long — the whole tangle of the creature's bonds worn away — while still alive he savours the rasa whose name is supreme bliss.
source: Soundarya Lahari 99 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: Do you treat joy as something scheduled for after your obligations end, or as something to be tasted while still carrying them?

translations.hi: तुम्हारा भजन करने वाला सरस्वती और लक्ष्मी दोनों के साथ विहार करता है — विधाता और हरि का प्रतिस्पर्धी बनकर; अपने रमणीय रूप से वह रति के पातिव्रत्य तक को ढीला कर देता है। दीर्घ आयु जीते हुए — पशु-भाव के पाशों की सारी उलझन काटकर — वह जीते-जी उस रस का आस्वाद लेता है जिसका नाम है परम आनन्द।

devanagari: प्रदीपज्वालाभिर्दिवसकरनीराजनविधिः / सुधासूतेश्चन्द्रोपलजललवैरर्घ्यरचना । / स्वकीयैरम्भोभिः सलिलनिधिसौहित्यकरणं / त्वदीयाभिर्वाग्भिस्तव जननि वाचां स्तुतिरियम् ॥100॥
iast: pradīpajvālābhirdivasakaranīrājanavidhiḥ / sudhāsūteścandropalajalalavairarghyaracanā । / svakīyairambhobhiḥ salilanidhisauhityakaraṇaṃ / tvadīyābhirvāgbhistava janani vācāṃ stutiriyam ॥100॥
sayIt: pra-dee-pa-jvaa-LAA-bhir-di-va-sa-ka-ra-nee-RAA-ja-na-vi-dhih / soo-dhaa-SOO-taysh-chun-DRO-pa-la-ja-la-la-vai-rar-GHYA-ra-cha-naa / sva-kee-yai-rum-BHO-bhih sa-li-la-ni-dhi-sau-HIT-ya-ka-ra-num / tva-dee-YAA-bhir-VAAG-bhis-TA-va JA-na-ni VAA-chaam stoo-ti-ri-yum
translation: As the rite of arati offered to the sun with the flames of little lamps; as arghya made to the moon, nectar's own source, with drops of water sweated by moonstones; as the quenching of the ocean with its own waters — just so, Mother of all speech, is this hymn of praise to you, fashioned out of words that are already yours.
source: Soundarya Lahari 100 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: What have you been proud of giving that was, all along, first given to you?

translations.hi: जैसे नन्हें दीपों की लौ से सूर्य की आरती; जैसे चन्द्रकान्त मणियों से रिसी जल-बूँदों से अमृत के जनक चन्द्रमा को अर्घ्य; जैसे समुद्र का तर्पण उसी के जल से — ठीक वैसे ही, हे वाणी-मात्र की जननी, तुम्हारी यह स्तुति उन्हीं शब्दों से रची गई है जो पहले से तुम्हारे हैं।

devanagari: ।। इति श्रीमत्परमहंसपरिव्राजकाचार्यस्य / श्रीगोविन्दभगवत्पूज्यपादशिष्यस्य / श्रीमच्छङ्करभगवतः कृतौ सौन्दर्यलहरी सम्पूर्णा ।। / (अनुबन्धः / समानीतः पद्भ्यां मणिमुकुरतामम्बरमणि / र्भयादास्यादन्तःस्तिमितकिरणश्रेणिमसृणः । / दधाति त्वद्वक्त्रंप्रतिफलनमश्रान्तविकचं / निरातङ्कं चन्द्रान्निजहृदयपङ्केरुहमिव ॥101॥
iast: ।। iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya / śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya / śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau saundaryalaharī sampūrṇā ।। / (anubandhaḥ / samānītaḥ padbhyāṃ maṇimukuratāmambaramaṇi / rbhayādāsyādantaḥstimitakiraṇaśreṇimasṛṇaḥ । / dadhāti tvadvaktraṃpratiphalanamaśrāntavikacaṃ / nirātaṅkaṃ candrānnijahṛdayapaṅkeruhamiva ॥101॥
sayIt: i-ti shree-mut-pa-ra-ma-HUN-sa-pa-ri-vraa-ja-KAA-chaar-yas-ya / shree-go-VIN-da-bha-ga-vat-POOJ-ya-paa-da-SHISH-yas-ya / shree-much-CHUN-ka-ra-bha-ga-va-tah kri-TAU saun-dar-ya-la-ha-REE sum-POOR-naa / (a-noo-BUN-dhah) / sa-maa-NEE-tah pud-BHYAAM ma-ni-moo-koo-ra-TAA-mum-ba-ra-ma-nih / bha-YAA-daas-YAA-dan-tah-sti-mi-ta-ki-ra-na-SHRAY-ni-ma-sri-nah / da-DHAA-ti tvad-VAKT-rum pra-ti-pha-la-nam ash-RAAN-ta-vi-ka-chum / ni-raa-TUN-kum chun-DRAAN-ni-ja-hri-da-ya-pun-KAY-roo-ha-mi-va
translation: [Colophon:] Thus the Saundarya Lahari, the work of the glorious Shankara Bhagavat — disciple of Shri Govinda Bhagavatpujyapada, master among wandering paramahamsa teachers — is complete. [Appendix verse:] The jewel of the sky, brought by your feet to the state of a jewelled mirror — its ranks of rays stilled within and softened, as if in awe of your face — holds your face's reflection, tirelessly in bloom, unafraid of the moon, as though it were the lotus of its own heart.
source: Soundarya Lahari 101 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: What brightness in your life would keep blooming even if every light around it were outshone?

translations.hi: [पुष्पिका:] इस प्रकार परमहंस-परिव्राजकाचार्य श्रीगोविन्द भगवत्पूज्यपाद के शिष्य श्रीमान् शंकर भगवान् की कृति सौन्दर्यलहरी सम्पूर्ण हुई। [अनुबन्ध-श्लोक:] आकाश का मणि — सूर्य — तुम्हारे चरणों के आगे मणि-दर्पण की दशा को पहुँच गया है; मानो तुम्हारे मुख के आगे संकोच से उसकी किरण-पंक्तियाँ भीतर ही थमकर कोमल हो गई हैं। उसमें वह तुम्हारे मुख का प्रतिबिम्ब धारण करता है — अथक खिला हुआ, चन्द्रमा से निर्भय — मानो अपने ही हृदय का कमल हो।

devanagari: समुद्भूतस्थूलस्तनभरमुरश्चारु हसितं / कटाक्षे कन्दर्पः कतिचन कदम्बद्युति वपुः । / हरस्य त्वद्भ्रान्तिं मनसि जनयन्ति स्म विमलाः / जनयामास मदनो, जनयन्तः समतुलां, जनयन्ता सुवदने / भवत्या ये भक्ताः परिणतिरमीषामियमुमे ॥102॥
iast: samudbhūtasthūlastanabharamuraścāru hasitaṃ / kaṭākṣe kandarpaḥ katicana kadambadyuti vapuḥ । / harasya tvadbhrāntiṃ manasi janayanti sma vimalāḥ / janayāmāsa madano, janayantaḥ samatulāṃ, janayantā suvadane / bhavatyā ye bhaktāḥ pariṇatiramīṣāmiyamume ॥102॥
sayIt: sa-mood-BHOO-ta-sthoo-la-sta-na-bha-ra-moo-rash-CHAA-roo ha-si-tum / ka-TAAK-shay kan-DAR-pah ka-ti-cha-na ka-dum-ba-DYOO-ti va-pooh / ha-RAS-ya tvad-BHRAAN-tim MA-na-si ja-na-YAN-ti sma vi-ma-laah / bha-vat-YAA yay bhak-TAAH pa-ri-na-ti-ra-mee-SHAA-mi-ya-moo-may
translation: A bosom heavy with full breasts, a lovely smile, the god of love dwelling in a side-glance, a body with the sheen of kadamba blossoms — with these, O Uma, certain stainless devotees of yours have stirred in Hara's own mind the illusion that they were you: such is the ripening your devotion works in those who are yours.
source: Soundarya Lahari 102 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: Whose likeness are your daily attentions slowly working into you?

translations.hi: भरे उरोजों से गुरु वक्ष, मनोहर मुस्कान, कटाक्ष में बसा कामदेव, कदम्ब-पुष्पों की आभा वाली देह — हे उमा, तुम्हारे कुछ निर्मल भक्तों ने इन्हीं से हर के मन में यह भ्रम जगा दिया कि वे तुम ही हो: जो तुम्हारे हो जाते हैं, तुम्हारी भक्ति उन्हें ऐसे ही पकाकर ढाल देती है।

devanagari: निधे नित्यस्मेरे निरवधिगुणे नीतिनिपुणे / निराघातज्ञाने नियमपरचित्तैकनिलये । / नियत्या निर्मुक्ते निखिलनिगमान्तस्तुतिपदे / निरातङ्के नित्ये निगमय ममापि स्तुतिमिमाम् ॥103॥
iast: nidhe nityasmere niravadhiguṇe nītinipuṇe / nirāghātajñāne niyamaparacittaikanilaye । / niyatyā nirmukte nikhilanigamāntastutipade / nirātaṅke nitye nigamaya mamāpi stutimimām ॥103॥
sayIt: ni-DHAY nit-ya-SMAY-ray ni-ra-va-dhi-goo-NAY nee-ti-ni-poo-NAY / ni-raa-GHAA-ta-gyaa-NAY ni-ya-ma-pa-ra-chit-TAI-ka-ni-la-yay / ni-yat-YAA nir-MOOK-tay ni-khi-la-ni-ga-MAAN-ta-stoo-ti-pa-day / ni-raa-TUN-kay NIT-yay ni-ga-ma-ya ma-MAA-pi stoo-ti-mi-maam
translation: O treasure; ever-smiling one; you of boundless virtues, skilled in right guidance; you whose knowledge nothing obstructs; sole dwelling of hearts given to discipline; you whom necessity itself does not bind; you whom the crowning chapters of all the Vedas praise; you beyond fear; eternal one — receive this praise of mine as well, and let it be counted.
source: Soundarya Lahari 103 (traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya), sanskritdocuments.org ITRANS file, personal-study terms, https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/soundaryalahari.itx
reflection: At the end of your best effort, can you hand the work over and let its worth be decided by love rather than by you?

translations.hi: हे निधि! हे नित्य-मुस्कान वाली! हे असीम गुणों वाली, नीति में निपुण! हे अबाध ज्ञान वाली! हे संयम-परायण चित्तों की एकमात्र वास-भूमि! हे नियति के बन्धन से भी मुक्त! हे समस्त वेदान्तों की स्तुति की पात्र! हे निर्भय! हे नित्ये! — मेरी भी यह स्तुति स्वीकार करो, और उसे अपनी गिनती में ले लो।
